1.82.s:
sūta uvāca
vyapohanastavaṃ vakṣye sarvasiddhipradaṃ śubham
nandinaś ca mukhācchrutvā kumāreṇa mahātmanā //
1.82.d:
सूत उवाच
व्यपोहनस्तवं वक्ष्ये सर्वसिद्धिप्रदं शुभम्
नन्दिनश् च मुखाच्छ्रुत्वा कुमारेण महात्मना ॥
1.82.m:
Sūta said:
I shall proclaim the auspicious Vyapohana hymn that grants all accomplishments,
having heard it from the mouth of Nandin by the great-souled Kumāra,

1.82.s:
vyāsāya kathitaṃ tasmād bahumānena vai mayā
namaḥ śivāya śuddhāya nirmalāya yaśasvine //
1.82.d:
व्यासाय कथितं तस्माद् बहुमानेन वै मया
नमः शिवाय शुद्धाय निर्मलाय यशस्विने ॥
1.82.m:
and by him told to Vyāsa, [and] from him indeed by me with great respect.
Salutation to Śiva, the pure, the stainless, the renowned,

1.82.s:
duṣṭāntakāya sarvāya bhavāya paramātmane
pañcavaktro daśabhujo hy akṣapañcadaśairyutaḥ //
1.82.d:
दुष्टान्तकाय सर्वाय भवाय परमात्मने
पञ्चवक्त्रो दशभुजो ह्य् अक्षपञ्चदशैर्युतः ॥
1.82.m:
the destroyer of the wicked, to Śarva, to Bhava, to the Supreme Self,
who has five faces, ten arms, and is endowed with fifteen eyes.

1.82.s:
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ
sarvajñaḥ sarvagaḥ śāntaḥ sarvopari susaṃsthitaḥ //
1.82.d:
शुद्धस्फटिकसंकाशः सर्वाभरणभूषितः
सर्वज्ञः सर्वगः शान्तः सर्वोपरि सुसंस्थितः ॥
1.82.m: Resembling pure crystal, adorned with all ornaments, / omniscient, omnipresent, tranquil, seated above all,

1.82.s:
padmāsanasthaḥ someśaḥ pāpamāśu vyapohatu
īśānaḥ puruṣaścaiva aghoraḥ sadya eva ca //
1.82.d:
पद्मासनस्थः सोमेशः पापमाशु व्यपोहतु
ईशानः पुरुषश्चैव अघोरः सद्य एव च ॥
1.82.m: seated on a lotus throne, may Someśa quickly remove my sin; / and Īśāna, Puruṣa, Aghora, and Sadyojāta,

1.82.s:
vāmadevaś ca bhagavān pāpamāśu vyapohatu
anantaḥ sarvavidyeśaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvadaḥ prabhuḥ //
1.82.d:
वामदेवश् च भगवान् पापमाशु व्यपोहतु
अनन्तः सर्वविद्येशः सर्वज्ञः सर्वदः प्रभुः ॥
1.82.m: and the lord Vāmadeva—may he quickly remove my sin. / Ananta, lord of all lore, omniscient, all-giving sovereign,

1.82.s:
śivadhyānaikasampannaḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
sūkṣmaḥ surāsureśāno viśveśo gaṇapūjitaḥ //
1.82.d:
शिवध्यानैकसम्पन्नः स मे पापं व्यपोहतु
सूक्ष्मः सुरासुरेशानो विश्वेशो गणपूजितः ॥
1.82.m: wholly endowed with meditation on Śiva: may he remove my sin. / Sūkṣma, ruler of gods and asuras, lord of the universe, worshipped by the gaṇas,

1.82.s:
śivadhyānaikasampannaḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
śivottamo mahāpūjyaḥ śivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ //
1.82.d:
शिवध्यानैकसम्पन्नः स मे पापं व्यपोहतु
शिवोत्तमो महापूज्यः शिवध्यानपरायणः ॥
1.82.m: wholly endowed with meditation on Śiva: may he remove my sin. / Śivottama, greatly worthy of worship, intent on meditation on Śiva,

1.82.s:
sarvagaḥ sarvadaḥ śāntaḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
ekākṣo bhagavānīśaḥ śivārcanaparāyaṇaḥ //
1.82.d:
सर्वगः सर्वदः शान्तः स मे पापं व्यपोहतु
एकाक्षो भगवानीशः शिवार्चनपरायणः ॥
1.82.m: omnipresent, all-giving, tranquil: may he remove my sin. / The one-eyed lord Īśa, devoted to the worship of Śiva,

1.82.s:
śivadhyānaikasampannaḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
trimūrtir bhagavān īśaḥ śivabhaktiprabodhakaḥ //
1.82.d:
शिवध्यानैकसम्पन्नः स मे पापं व्यपोहतु
त्रिमूर्तिर् भगवान् ईशः शिवभक्तिप्रबोधकः ॥
1.82.m: wholly endowed with meditation on Śiva: may he remove my sin. / The three-formed lord Īśa, who awakens devotion to Śiva,

1.82.s:
śivadhyānaikasampannaḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
śrīkaṇṭhaḥ śrīpatiḥ śrīmāñ śivadhyānarataḥ sadā //
1.82.d:
शिवध्यानैकसम्पन्नः स मे पापं व्यपोहतु
श्रीकण्ठः श्रीपतिः श्रीमाञ् शिवध्यानरतः सदा ॥
1.82.m: wholly endowed with meditation on Śiva: may he remove my sin. / Śrīkaṇṭha, lord of Śrī, glorious, ever delighting in meditation on Śiva,

1.82.s:
śivārcanarataḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
trailokyanamitā devī solkākārā purātanī //
1.82.d:
शिवार्चनरतः श्रीमान् स मे पापं व्यपोहतु
त्रैलोक्यनमिता देवी सोल्काकारा पुरातनी ॥
1.82.m: delighting in the worship of Śiva, glorious: may he remove my sin. / The ancient goddess bowed to by the three worlds, meteor-like in form,

1.82.s:
śivārcanarataḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
trailokyanamitā devī solkākārā purātanī //
1.82.d:
शिवार्चनरतः श्रीमान् स मे पापं व्यपोहतु
त्रैलोक्यनमिता देवी सोल्काकारा पुरातनी ॥
1.82.m: delighting in the worship of Śiva, glorious: may he remove my sin. / The ancient goddess bowed to by the three worlds, meteor-like in form,

1.82.s:
dākṣāyaṇī mahādevī gaurī haimavatī śubhā
ekaparṇāgrajā saumyā tathā vai caikapāṭalā //
1.82.d:
दाक्षायणी महादेवी गौरी हैमवती शुभा
एकपर्णाग्रजा सौम्या तथा वै चैकपाटला ॥
1.82.m: Dākṣāyaṇī, Mahādevī, Gaurī, the auspicious daughter of Himavat, / gentle elder sister of Ekaparṇā, and likewise Ekapāṭalā,

1.82.s:
aparṇā varadā devī varadānaikatatparā
umā suraharā sākṣāt kauśikī vā kapardinī //
1.82.d:
अपर्णा वरदा देवी वरदानैकतत्परा
उमा सुरहरा साक्षात् कौशिकी वा कपर्दिनी ॥
1.82.m: Aparṇā, boon-bestowing goddess, intent solely on giving boons, / Umā, who destroys the enemies of the gods, Kauśikī, or the matted-haired goddess,

1.82.s:
khaṭvāṅgadhāriṇī divyā karāgratarupallavā
naigameyādibhir divyaiś caturbhiḥ putrakairvṛtā //
1.82.d:
खट्वाङ्गधारिणी दिव्या कराग्रतरुपल्लवा
नैगमेयादिभिर् दिव्यैश् चतुर्भिः पुत्रकैर्वृता ॥
1.82.m: bearing a skull-topped staff, divine, the tips of her hands like young tree sprouts, / surrounded by her four divine sons beginning with Naigameya,

1.82.s:
menāyā nandinī devī vārijā vārijekṣaṇā
aṃbāyā vītaśokasya nandinaś ca mahātmanaḥ //
1.82.d:
मेनाया नन्दिनी देवी वारिजा वारिजेक्षणा
अंबाया वीतशोकस्य नन्दिनश् च महात्मनः ॥
1.82.m: the goddess who delights Menā, born of the waters, lotus-eyed, / [consort] of the high-souled Nandin, free from sorrow, of Ambā,

1.82.s:
śubhāvatyāḥ sakhī śāntā pañcacūḍā varapradā
sṛṣṭyarthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ prakṛtitvaṃ gatāvyayā //
1.82.d:
शुभावत्याः सखी शान्ता पञ्चचूडा वरप्रदा
सृष्ट्यर्थं सर्वभूतानां प्रकृतित्वं गताव्यया ॥
1.82.m: friend of Śubhāvatī, tranquil, Pañcacūḍā, bestower of boons, / who, for the creation of all beings, has become imperishable Prakṛti,

1.82.s:
trayoviṃśatibhis tattvair mahadādyair vijṛmbhitā
lakṣmyādiśaktibhir nityaṃ namitā nandanandinī //
1.82.d:
त्रयोविंशतिभिस् तत्त्वैर् महदाद्यैर् विजृम्भिता
लक्ष्म्यादिशक्तिभिर् नित्यं नमिता नन्दनन्दिनी ॥
1.82.m: manifest through the twenty-three principles beginning with Mahat, / ever bowed down to by the powers beginning with Lakṣmī, who brings joy to Nanda,

1.82.s:
manonmanī mahādevī māyāvī maṇḍanapriyā
māyayā yā jagatsarvaṃ brahmādyaṃ sacarācaram //
1.82.d:
मनोन्मनी महादेवी मायावी मण्डनप्रिया
मायया या जगत्सर्वं ब्रह्माद्यं सचराचरम् ॥
1.82.m: Manonmanī, Mahādevī, skilled in illusion, fond of ornaments, / who through her illusion [pervades] the entire universe, beginning with Brahmā, with all that moves and is still,

1.82.s:
kṣobhiṇī mohinī nityaṃ yogināṃ hṛdi saṃsthitā
ekānekasthitā loke indīvaranibhekṣaṇā //
1.82.d:
क्षोभिणी मोहिनी नित्यं योगिनां हृदि संस्थिता
एकानेकस्थिता लोके इन्दीवरनिभेक्षणा ॥
1.82.m: agitating, deluding, ever abiding in the hearts of yogins, / one yet manifold in the world, with eyes resembling the blue lotus,

1.82.s:
bhaktyā paramayā nityaṃ sarvadevairabhiṣṭutā
gaṇendrāmbhojagarbhendrayamavitteśapūrvakaiḥ //
1.82.d:
भक्त्या परमया नित्यं सर्वदेवैरभिष्टुता
गणेन्द्राम्भोजगर्भेन्द्रयमवित्तेशपूर्वकैः ॥
1.82.m: ever praised with supreme devotion by all the gods, / by the lords of the gaṇas, Brahmā, Indra, Yama, and the lord of wealth [Kubera],

1.82.s:
saṃstutā jananī teṣāṃ sarvopadravanāśinī
bhaktānāmārtihā bhavyā bhavabhāvavināśanī //
1.82.d:
संस्तुता जननी तेषां सर्वोपद्रवनाशिनी
भक्तानामार्तिहा भव्या भवभावविनाशनी ॥
1.82.m: praised by them as mother, destroyer of all afflictions, / remover of distress for her devotees, auspicious, destroyer of worldly existence,

1.82.s:
bhuktimuktipradā divyā bhaktānāmaprayatnataḥ
sā me sākṣānmahādevī pāpam āśu vyapohatu //
1.82.d:
भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदा दिव्या भक्तानामप्रयत्नतः
सा मे साक्षान्महादेवी पापम् आशु व्यपोहतु ॥
1.82.m: divine bestower of enjoyment and liberation effortlessly to devotees: / may that Mahādevī herself quickly remove my sin.

1.82.s:
caṇḍaḥ sarvagaṇeśāno mukhācchaṃbhorvinirgataḥ
śivārcanarataḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
1.82.d:
चण्डः सर्वगणेशानो मुखाच्छंभोर्विनिर्गतः
शिवार्चनरतः श्रीमान् स मे पापं व्यपोहतु ॥
1.82.m: Caṇḍa, ruler of all gaṇas, emerged from the mouth of Śambhu, / devoted to the worship of Śiva, glorious: may he remove my sin.

1.82.s:
śālaṅkāyanaputrastu halamārgotthitaḥ prabhuḥ
jāmātā marutāṃ devaḥ sarvabhūtamaheśvaraḥ //
1.82.d:
शालङ्कायनपुत्रस्तु हलमार्गोत्थितः प्रभुः
जामाता मरुतां देवः सर्वभूतमहेश्वरः ॥
1.82.m: The son of Śālaṅkāyana, who arose from the furrow of the plow, the lord, / son-in-law of the Maruts, the deity, great lord of all beings,

1.82.s:
sarvagaḥ sarvadṛk śarvaḥ sarveśasadṛśaḥ prabhuḥ
sanārāyaṇakair devaiḥ sendracandradivākaraiḥ //
1.82.d:
सर्वगः सर्वदृक् शर्वः सर्वेशसदृशः प्रभुः
सनारायणकैर् देवैः सेन्द्रचन्द्रदिवाकरैः ॥
1.82.m: omnipresent, all-seeing Śarva, the lord equal to the Lord of All, / [praised] by the gods together with Nārāyaṇa, Indra, the moon, and the sun,

1.82.s:
siddhaiś ca yakṣagandharvair bhūtairbhūtavidhāyakaiḥ
uragairṛṣibhiścaiva brahmaṇā ca mahātmanā //
1.82.d:
सिद्धैश् च यक्षगन्धर्वैर् भूतैर्भूतविधायकैः
उरगैरृषिभिश्चैव ब्रह्मणा च महात्मना ॥
1.82.m: by siddhas, yakṣas, gandharvas, spirits, the creators of beings, / serpents, sages, and the great-souled Brahmā—

1.82.s:
stutastrailokyanāthastu munirantaḥ puraṃ sthitaḥ
sarvadā pūjitaḥ sarvair nandī pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
1.82.d:
स्तुतस्त्रैलोक्यनाथस्तु मुनिरन्तः पुरं स्थितः
सर्वदा पूजितः सर्वैर् नन्दी पापं व्यपोहतु ॥
1.82.m: the praised lord of the three worlds, the sage dwelling in the inner sanctuary, / ever worshipped by all: may Nandin remove my sin.

1.82.s:
mahākāyo mahātejā mahādeva ivāparaḥ
śivārcanarataḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
1.82.d:
महाकायो महातेजा महादेव इवापरः
शिवार्चनरतः श्रीमान् स मे पापं व्यपोहतु ॥
1.82.m: Of vast body, of great splendour, like another Mahādeva, / devoted to the worship of Śiva, glorious: may he remove my sin.

1.82.s:
merumandārakailāsataṭakūṭaprabhedanaḥ
airāvatādibhir divyair diggajaiś ca supūjitaḥ //
1.82.d:
मेरुमन्दारकैलासतटकूटप्रभेदनः
ऐरावतादिभिर् दिव्यैर् दिग्गजैश् च सुपूजितः ॥
1.82.m: He who cleaves the slopes and peaks of Meru, Mandara, and Kailāsa, / well-worshipped by Airāvata and the other divine elephants of the quarters,

1.82.s:
saptapātālapādaś ca saptadvīporujaṅghakaḥ
saptārṇavāṅkuśaścaiva sarvatīrthodaraḥ śivaḥ //
1.82.d:
सप्तपातालपादश् च सप्तद्वीपोरुजङ्घकः
सप्तार्णवाङ्कुशश्चैव सर्वतीर्थोदरः शिवः ॥
1.82.m: whose feet are the seven subterranean worlds, whose thighs and shanks are the seven continents, / whose goad is the seven oceans, whose belly contains all sacred tirthas, the auspicious one,

1.82.s:
ākāśadeho digbāhuḥ somasūryāgnilocanaḥ
hatāsuramahāvṛkṣo brahmavidyāmahotkaṭaḥ //
1.82.d:
आकाशदेहो दिग्बाहुः सोमसूर्याग्निलोचनः
हतासुरमहावृक्षो ब्रह्मविद्यामहोत्कटः ॥
1.82.m: whose body is space, whose arms are the quarters, whose eyes are the moon, sun, and fire, / who uproots the great trees of the asuras, formidable with the knowledge of Brahman,

1.82.s:
brahmādyādhoraṇair divyair yogapāśasamanvitaiḥ
baddho hṛtpuṇḍarīkākhye staṃbhe vṛttiṃ nirudhya ca //
1.82.d:
ब्रह्माद्याधोरणैर् दिव्यैर् योगपाशसमन्वितैः
बद्धो हृत्पुण्डरीकाख्ये स्तंभे वृत्तिं निरुध्य च ॥
1.82.m: bound by divine elephant-drivers beginning with Brahmā equipped with nooses of yoga / to the post called the heart-lotus, having restrained his mental fluctuations,

1.82.s:
nāgendravaktro yaḥ sākṣād gaṇakoṭiśatairvṛtaḥ
śivadhyānaikasampannaḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
1.82.d:
नागेन्द्रवक्त्रो यः साक्षाद् गणकोटिशतैर्वृतः
शिवध्यानैकसम्पन्नः स मे पापं व्यपोहतु ॥
1.82.m: he who truly has the face of an elephant-king, surrounded by hundreds of millions of gaṇas, / wholly endowed with meditation on Śiva: may he remove my sin.

1.82.s:
bhṛṅgīśaḥ piṅgalākṣo 'sau bhasitāśastu dehayuk
śivārcanarataḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
1.82.d:
भृङ्गीशः पिङ्गलाक्षो ऽसौ भसिताशस्तु देहयुक्
शिवार्चनरतः श्रीमान् स मे पापं व्यपोहतु ॥
1.82.m: Bhṛṅgīśa, reddish-brown-eyed, whose body is covered in ash, / devoted to the worship of Śiva, glorious: may he remove my sin.

1.82.s:
caturbhistanubhir nityaṃ sarvāsuranibarhaṇaḥ
skandaḥ śaktidharaḥ śāntaḥ senānīḥ śikhivāhanaḥ //
1.82.d:
चतुर्भिस्तनुभिर् नित्यं सर्वासुरनिबर्हणः
स्कन्दः शक्तिधरः शान्तः सेनानीः शिखिवाहनः ॥
1.82.m: Who constantly destroys all asuras through his four forms, / Skanda, spear-bearer, tranquil, general, having the peacock for his mount,

1.82.s:
devasenāpatiḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
bhavaḥ śarvastatheśāno rudraḥ paśupatis tathā //
1.82.d:
देवसेनापतिः श्रीमान् स मे पापं व्यपोहतु
भवः शर्वस्तथेशानो रुद्रः पशुपतिस् तथा ॥
1.82.m: commander of the army of the gods, glorious: may he remove my sin. / Bhava, Śarva, as well as Īśāna, Rudra, and Paśupati,

1.82.s:
ugro bhīmo mahādevaḥ śivārcanarataḥ sadā
etāḥ pāpaṃ vyapohantu mūrtayaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ //
1.82.d:
उग्रो भीमो महादेवः शिवार्चनरतः सदा
एताः पापं व्यपोहन्तु मूर्तयः परमेष्ठिनः ॥
1.82.m: Ugra, Bhīma, Mahādeva, ever devoted to the worship of Śiva: / may these forms of the Supreme Lord remove my sin.

1.82.s:
mahādevaḥ śivo rudraḥ śaṅkaro nīlalohitaḥ
īśāno vijayo bhīmo devadevo bhavodbhavaḥ //
1.82.d:
महादेवः शिवो रुद्रः शङ्करो नीललोहितः
ईशानो विजयो भीमो देवदेवो भवोद्भवः ॥
1.82.m: Mahādeva, Śiva, Rudra, Śaṅkara, Nīlalohita, / Īśāna, Vijaya, Bhīma, God of Gods, Bhavodbhava,

1.82.s:
kapālīśaś ca vijñeyo rudrā rudrāṃśasaṃbhavāḥ
śivapraṇāmasampannā vyapohantu malaṃ mama //
1.82.d:
कपालीशश् च विज्ञेयो रुद्रा रुद्रांशसंभवाः
शिवप्रणामसम्पन्ना व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम ॥
1.82.m: and Kapālīśa to be known—these Rudras born from parts of Rudra, / devoted to bowing before Śiva: may they remove my impurity.

1.82.s:
vikartano vivasvāṃś ca mārtaṇḍo bhāskaro raviḥ
lokaprakāśakaścaiva lokasākṣītrivikramaḥ //
1.82.d:
विकर्तनो विवस्वांश् च मार्तण्डो भास्करो रविः
लोकप्रकाशकश्चैव लोकसाक्षीत्रिविक्रमः ॥
1.82.m: Vikartana, Vivasvat, Mārtaṇḍa, Bhāskara, Ravi, / illuminator of the worlds, witness of the worlds, Trivikrama,

1.82.s:
ādityaś ca tathā sūryaś cāṃśumāṃś ca divākaraḥ
ete vai dvādaśādityā vyapohantu malaṃ mama //
1.82.d:
आदित्यश् च तथा सूर्यश् चांशुमांश् च दिवाकरः
एते वै द्वादशादित्या व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम ॥
1.82.m: Āditya, and likewise Sūrya, Aṃśumat, and Divākara: / may these twelve Ādityas remove my impurity.

1.82.s:
gaganaṃ sparśanaṃ tejo rasaś ca pṛthivī tathā
candraḥ sūryastathātmā ca tanavaḥ śivabhāṣitāḥ //
1.82.d:
गगनं स्पर्शनं तेजो रसश् च पृथिवी तथा
चन्द्रः सूर्यस्तथात्मा च तनवः शिवभाषिताः ॥
1.82.m: Space, wind, fire, water, and earth, / the moon, the sun, and the self—proclaimed as the forms of Śiva:

1.82.s:
pāpaṃ vyapohantu mama bhayaṃ nirṇāśayantu me
vāsavaḥ pāvakaścaiva yamo nirṛtireva ca //
1.82.d:
पापं व्यपोहन्तु मम भयं निर्णाशयन्तु मे
वासवः पावकश्चैव यमो निरृतिरेव च ॥
1.82.m: may they remove my sin, may they destroy my fear! / Vāsava, Pāvaka, Yama, and Nirṛti,

1.82.s:
varuṇo vāyusomau ca īśāno bhagavān hariḥ
pitāmahaś ca bhagavān śivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ //
1.82.d:
वरुणो वायुसोमौ च ईशानो भगवान् हरिः
पितामहश् च भगवान् शिवध्यानपरायणः ॥
1.82.m: Varuṇa, Vāyu and Soma, Īśāna, the lord Hari, / and the lord Pitāmaha, intent on meditation on Śiva:

1.82.s:
ete pāpaṃ vyapohantu manasā karmaṇā kṛtam
nabhasvānsparśano vāyur anilo mārutas tathā //
1.82.d:
एते पापं व्यपोहन्तु मनसा कर्मणा कृतम्
नभस्वान्स्पर्शनो वायुर् अनिलो मारुतस् तथा ॥
1.82.m: may these remove the sin committed by my mind or action. / Nabhasvat, Sparśana, Vāyu, Anila, and Māruta,

1.82.s:
prāṇaḥ prāṇeśajīveśau mārutaḥ śivabhāṣitāḥ
śivārcanaratāḥ sarve vyapohantu malaṃ mama //
1.82.d:
प्राणः प्राणेशजीवेशौ मारुतः शिवभाषिताः
शिवार्चनरताः सर्वे व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम ॥
1.82.m: Prāṇa, the lords of breath and life, Māruta, declared by Śiva, / all devoted to the worship of Śiva: may they remove my impurity.

1.82.s:
khecarī vasucārī ca brahmeśo brahmabrahmadhīḥ
suṣeṇaḥ śāśvataḥ pṛṣṭaḥ supuṣṭaś ca mahābalaḥ //
1.82.d:
खेचरी वसुचारी च ब्रह्मेशो ब्रह्मब्रह्मधीः
सुषेणः शाश्वतः पृष्टः सुपुष्टश् च महाबलः ॥
1.82.m: Khecarī, Vasucārī, Brahmeśa, Brahmabrahmadhī, / Suṣeṇa, Śāśvata, Pṛṣṭa, Supuṣṭa, and Mahābala:

1.82.s:
ete vai cāraṇāḥ śaṃbhoḥ pūjayātīva bhāvitāḥ
vyapohantu malaṃ sarvaṃ pāpaṃ caiva mayā kṛtam //
1.82.d:
एते वै चारणाः शंभोः पूजयातीव भाविताः
व्यपोहन्तु मलं सर्वं पापं चैव मया कृतम् ॥
1.82.m: these Cāraṇas of Śambhu, greatly elevated through worship, / may they remove all impurity and sin committed by me.

1.82.s:
mantrajño mantravit prājño mantrarāṭ siddhapūjitaḥ
siddhavatparamaḥ siddhaḥ sarvasiddhipradāyinaḥ //
1.82.d:
मन्त्रज्ञो मन्त्रवित् प्राज्ञो मन्त्रराट् सिद्धपूजितः
सिद्धवत्परमः सिद्धः सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायिनः ॥
1.82.m: Knower of mantras, master of mantras, wise, king of mantras, worshipped by the siddhas, / supreme like a siddha, perfected ones who grant all accomplishments:

1.82.s:
vyapohantu malaṃ sarve siddhāḥ śivapadārcakāḥ
yakṣo yakṣeśadhanado jṛmbhako maṇibhadrakaḥ //
1.82.d:
व्यपोहन्तु मलं सर्वे सिद्धाः शिवपदार्चकाः
यक्षो यक्षेशधनदो जृम्भको मणिभद्रकः ॥
1.82.m: may all the siddhas, worshippers of Śiva's feet, remove my impurity. / The Yakṣa, the lord of yakṣas who bestows wealth, Jṛmbhaka, Maṇibhadra,

1.82.s:
pūrṇabhadreśvaro mālī śitikuṇḍalireva ca
narendraścaiva yakṣeśā vyapohantu malaṃ mama //
1.82.d:
पूर्णभद्रेश्वरो माली शितिकुण्डलिरेव च
नरेन्द्रश्चैव यक्षेशा व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम ॥
1.82.m: Pūrṇabhadreśvara, Mālī, and Śitikuṇḍalin, / and Narendra, lords of yakṣas: may they remove my impurity.

1.82.s:
anantaḥ kulikaścaiva vāsukistakṣakastathā
karkoṭako mahāpadmaḥ śaṅkhapālo mahābalaḥ //
1.82.d:
अनन्तः कुलिकश्चैव वासुकिस्तक्षकस्तथा
कर्कोटको महापद्मः शङ्खपालो महाबलः ॥
1.82.m: Ananta, Kulika, Vāsuki, and Takṣaka, / Karkoṭaka, Mahāpadma, and the mighty Śaṅkhapāla,

1.82.s:
śivapraṇāmasampannāḥ śivadehaprabhūṣaṇāḥ
mama pāpaṃ vyapohantu viṣaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam //
1.82.d:
शिवप्रणामसम्पन्नाः शिवदेहप्रभूषणाः
मम पापं व्यपोहन्तु विषं स्थावरजङ्गमम् ॥
1.82.m: devoted to bowing before Śiva, adornments on Śiva's body— / may they remove my sin and poison, whether stationary or mobile.

1.82.s:
vīṇājñaḥ kinnaraścaiva surasenaḥ pramardanaḥ
atīśayaḥ sa prayogī gītajñaścaiva kinnarāḥ //
1.82.d:
वीणाज्ञः किन्नरश्चैव सुरसेनः प्रमर्दनः
अतीशयः स प्रयोगी गीतज्ञश्चैव किन्नराः ॥
1.82.m: The vīṇā-knowing Kinnara, Surasena, Pramardana, / the pre-eminent Prayogin, and Kinnaras skilled in song,

1.82.s:
śivapraṇāmasampannā vyapohantu malaṃ mama
vidyādharaś ca vibudho vidyārāśirvidāṃ varaḥ //
1.82.d:
शिवप्रणामसम्पन्ना व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम
विद्याधरश् च विबुधो विद्याराशिर्विदां वरः ॥
1.82.m: devoted to bowing before Śiva, may they remove my impurity. / The Vidyādhara, Vibudha, the treasury of learning, the best of the wise,

1.82.s:
vibuddho vibudhaḥ śrīmān kṛtajñaś ca mahāyaśāḥ
ete vidyādharāḥ sarve śivadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ //
1.82.d:
विबुद्धो विबुधः श्रीमान् कृतज्ञश् च महायशाः
एते विद्याधराः सर्वे शिवध्यानपरायणाः ॥
1.82.m: Vibuddha, the wise Vibudha, the glorious, grateful, and widely renowned— / all these Vidyādharas, intent on meditating upon Śiva,

1.82.s:
vyapohantu malaṃ ghoraṃ mahādevaprasādataḥ
vāmadevī mahājambhaḥ kālanemirmahābalaḥ //
1.82.d:
व्यपोहन्तु मलं घोरं महादेवप्रसादतः
वामदेवी महाजम्भः कालनेमिर्महाबलः ॥
1.82.m: may they remove terrible impurity through the grace of Mahādeva. / Vāmadevī, Mahājambha, the mighty Kālanemi,

1.82.s:
sugrīvo mardakaścaiva piṅgalo devamardanaḥ
prahrādaścāpyanuhrādaḥ saṃhrādaḥ kila bāṣkalau //
1.82.d:
सुग्रीवो मर्दकश्चैव पिङ्गलो देवमर्दनः
प्रह्रादश्चाप्यनुह्रादः संह्रादः किल बाष्कलौ ॥
1.82.m: Sugrīva, Mardaka, Piṅgala, Devamardana, / Prahrāda, Anuhrāda, Saṃhrāda, indeed the two Bāṣkalas,

1.82.s:
jambhaḥ kuṃbhaś ca māyāvī kārtavīryaḥ kṛtaṃjayaḥ
ete 'surā mahātmāno mahādevaparāyaṇāḥ //
1.82.d:
जम्भः कुंभश् च मायावी कार्तवीर्यः कृतंजयः
एते ऽसुरा महात्मानो महादेवपरायणाः ॥
1.82.m: Jambha, Kumbha the wily, Kārtavīrya, Kṛtañjaya— / these high-souled Asuras, devoted to Mahādeva,

1.82.s:
vyapohantu bhayaṃ ghoram āsuraṃ bhāvameva ca
garutmān khagatiścaiva pakṣirāṭ nāgamardanaḥ //
1.82.d:
व्यपोहन्तु भयं घोरम् आसुरं भावमेव च
गरुत्मान् खगतिश्चैव पक्षिराट् नागमर्दनः ॥
1.82.m: may they remove terrible fear and the Asura nature itself. / Garutmat, Khagati, king of birds, crusher of serpents,

1.82.s:
nāgaśatrur hiraṇyāṅgo vainateyaḥ prabhañjanaḥ
nāgāśīrviṣanāśaś ca viṣṇuvāhana eva ca //
1.82.d:
नागशत्रुर् हिरण्याङ्गो वैनतेयः प्रभञ्जनः
नागाशीर्विषनाशश् च विष्णुवाहन एव च ॥
1.82.m: the enemy of serpents, golden-limbed, son of Vinatā, Prabhañjana, / the devourer of snakes, destroyer of venom, and mount of Viṣṇu—

1.82.s:
ete hiraṇyavarṇābhā garuḍā viṣṇuvāhanāḥ
nānābharaṇasampannā vyapohantu malaṃ mama //
1.82.d:
एते हिरण्यवर्णाभा गरुडा विष्णुवाहनाः
नानाभरणसम्पन्ना व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम ॥
1.82.m: these golden-hued Garuḍas, the mounts of Viṣṇu, / adorned with diverse ornaments, may they remove my impurity.

1.82.s:
agastyaś ca vasiṣṭhaś ca aṅgirā bhṛgureva ca
kāśyapo nāradaścaiva dadhīcaścyavanas tathā //
1.82.d:
अगस्त्यश् च वसिष्ठश् च अङ्गिरा भृगुरेव च
काश्यपो नारदश्चैव दधीचश्च्यवनस् तथा ॥
1.82.m: Agastya, Vasiṣṭha, Aṅgiras, and Bhṛgu, / Kāśyapa, Nārada, Dadhīca, and Cyavana,

1.82.s:
upamanyustathānye ca ṛṣayaḥ śivabhāvitāḥ
śivārcanaratāḥ sarve vyapohantu malaṃ mama //
1.82.d:
उपमन्युस्तथान्ये च ऋषयः शिवभाविताः
शिवार्चनरताः सर्वे व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम ॥
1.82.m: Upamanyu and other sages who contemplate Śiva, / all devoted to worshipping Śiva, may they remove my impurity.

1.82.s:
pitaraḥ pitāmahāś ca tathaiva prapitāmahāḥ
agniṣvāttā barhiṣadas tathā mātāmahādayaḥ //
1.82.d:
पितरः पितामहाश् च तथैव प्रपितामहाः
अग्निष्वात्ता बर्हिषदस् तथा मातामहादयः ॥
1.82.m: The fathers, the grandfathers, and the great-grandfathers, / the Agniṣvāttas, the Barhiṣads, and the maternal grandfathers and others,

1.82.s:
vyapohantu bhayaṃ pāpaṃ śivadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ
lakṣmīś ca dharaṇī caiva gāyatrī ca sarasvatī //
1.82.d:
व्यपोहन्तु भयं पापं शिवध्यानपरायणाः
लक्ष्मीश् च धरणी चैव गायत्री च सरस्वती ॥
1.82.m: intent on meditating upon Śiva, may they remove fear and sin. / Lakṣmī, Dharaṇī, Gāyatrī, and Sarasvatī,

1.82.s:
durgā uṣā śacī jyeṣṭhā mātaraḥ surapūjitāḥ
devānāṃ mātaraś caiva gaṇānāṃ mātaras tathā //
1.82.d:
दुर्गा उषा शची ज्येष्ठा मातरः सुरपूजिताः
देवानां मातरश् चैव गणानां मातरस् तथा ॥
1.82.m: Durgā, Uṣas, Śacī, Jyeṣṭhā, the mothers worshipped by the gods, / the mothers of the gods, and the mothers of the gaṇas,

1.82.s:
bhūtānāṃ mātaraḥ sarvā yatra yā gaṇamātaraḥ
prasādāddevadevasya vyapohantu malaṃ mama //
1.82.d:
भूतानां मातरः सर्वा यत्र या गणमातरः
प्रसादाद्देवदेवस्य व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम ॥
1.82.m: all the mothers of the bhūtas, and whatever mothers of the gaṇas are there— / by the grace of the God of gods, may they remove my impurity.

1.82.s:
urvaśī menakā caiva raṃbhā ratitilottamāḥ
sumukhī durmukhī caiva kāmukī kāmavardhanī //
1.82.d:
उर्वशी मेनका चैव रंभा रतितिलोत्तमाः
सुमुखी दुर्मुखी चैव कामुकी कामवर्धनी ॥
1.82.m: Urvaśī, Menakā, Rambhā, Rati, and Tilottamā, / Sumukhī, Durmukhī, Kāmukī, and Kāmavardhanī,

1.82.s:
tathānyāḥ sarvalokeṣu divyāścāpsarasas tathā
śivāya tāṇḍavaṃ nityaṃ kurvantyo 'tīva bhāvitāḥ //
1.82.d:
तथान्याः सर्वलोकेषु दिव्याश्चाप्सरसस् तथा
शिवाय ताण्डवं नित्यं कुर्वन्त्यो ऽतीव भाविताः ॥
1.82.m: and the other celestial Apsarases across all the worlds, / who constantly perform the tāṇḍava dance for Śiva with deep devotion,

1.82.s:
devyaḥ śivārcanaratā vyapohantu malaṃ mama
arkaḥ somo 'ṅgārakaś ca budhaścaiva bṛhaspatiḥ //
1.82.d:
देव्यः शिवार्चनरता व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम
अर्कः सोमो ऽङ्गारकश् च बुधश्चैव बृहस्पतिः ॥
1.82.m: divine women devoted to worshipping Śiva, may they remove my impurity. / The Sun, the Moon, Mars, Mercury, and Jupiter,

1.82.s:
śukraḥ śanaiścaraścaiva rāhuḥ ketustathaiva ca
vyapohantu bhayaṃ ghoraṃ grahapīḍāṃ śivārcakāḥ //
1.82.d:
शुक्रः शनैश्चरश्चैव राहुः केतुस्तथैव च
व्यपोहन्तु भयं घोरं ग्रहपीडां शिवार्चकाः ॥
1.82.m: Venus, Saturn, Rāhu, and Ketu— / worshippers of Śiva, may they remove terrible fear and affliction from the planets.

1.82.s:
meṣo vṛṣo 'tha mithunas tathā karkaṭakaḥ śubhaḥ
siṃhaś ca kanyā vipulā tulā vai vṛścikas tathā //
1.82.d:
मेषो वृषो ऽथ मिथुनस् तथा कर्कटकः शुभः
सिंहश् च कन्या विपुला तुला वै वृश्चिकस् तथा ॥
1.82.m: Aries, Taurus, Gemini, and auspicious Cancer, / Leo, large Virgo, Libra, and Scorpio,

1.82.s:
dhanuś ca makaraścaiva kuṃbho mīnastathaiva ca
rāśayo dvādaśa hyete śivapūjāparāyaṇāḥ //
1.82.d:
धनुश् च मकरश्चैव कुंभो मीनस्तथैव च
राशयो द्वादश ह्येते शिवपूजापरायणाः ॥
1.82.m: Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius, and Pisces— / these twelve zodiac signs, devoted to the worship of Śiva,

1.82.s:
vyapohantu bhayaṃ pāpaṃ prasādātparameṣṭhinaḥ
aśvinī bharaṇī caiva kṛttikā rohiṇī tathā //
1.82.d:
व्यपोहन्तु भयं पापं प्रसादात्परमेष्ठिनः
अश्विनी भरणी चैव कृत्तिका रोहिणी तथा ॥
1.82.m: may they remove fear and sin by the grace of the Supreme Lord. / Aśvinī, Bharaṇī, Kṛttikā, and Rohiṇī,

1.82.s:
śrīmanmṛgaśiraścārdrā punarvasupuṣyasārpakāḥ
maghā vai pūrvaphālgunya uttarāphālgunī tathā //
1.82.d:
श्रीमन्मृगशिरश्चार्द्रा पुनर्वसुपुष्यसार्पकाः
मघा वै पूर्वफाल्गुन्य उत्तराफाल्गुनी तथा ॥
1.82.m: splendid Mṛgaśiras, Ārdrā, Punarvasu, Puṣya, and Āśleṣā, / Maghā, Pūrvaphālgunī, and Uttaraphālgunī,

1.82.s:
hastacitrā tathā svātī viśākhā cānurādhikā
jyeṣṭhā mūlaṃ mahābhāgā pūrvāṣāḍhā tathaiva ca //
1.82.d:
हस्तचित्रा तथा स्वाती विशाखा चानुराधिका
ज्येष्ठा मूलं महाभागा पूर्वाषाढा तथैव च ॥
1.82.m: Hasta, Citrā, Svātī, Viśākhā, and Anurādhā, / Jyeṣṭhā, Mūla, fortunate Pūrvāṣāḍhā,

1.82.s:
uttarāṣāḍhikā caiva śravaṇaṃ ca śraviṣṭhikā
śatabhiṣak pūrvabhadrā tathā proṣṭhapadā tathā //
1.82.d:
उत्तराषाढिका चैव श्रवणं च श्रविष्ठिका
शतभिषक् पूर्वभद्रा तथा प्रोष्ठपदा तथा ॥
1.82.m: Uttarāṣāḍhā, Śravaṇa, Dhaniṣṭhā, / Śatabhiṣak, Pūrvabhādrapadā, and Uttarabhādrapadā,

1.82.s:
pauṣṇaṃ ca devyaḥ satataṃ vyapohantu malaṃ mama
jvaraḥ kumbhodaraścaiva śaṅkukarṇo mahābalaḥ //
1.82.d:
पौष्णं च देव्यः सततं व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम
ज्वरः कुम्भोदरश्चैव शङ्कुकर्णो महाबलः ॥
1.82.m: and Revatī—may these divine maidens constantly remove my impurity. / Jvara, Kumbhodara, the mighty Śaṅkukarṇa,

1.82.s:
mahākarṇaḥ prabhātaś ca mahābhūtapramardanaḥ
śyenajicchivadūtaś ca pramathāḥ prītivardhanāḥ //
1.82.d:
महाकर्णः प्रभातश् च महाभूतप्रमर्दनः
श्येनजिच्छिवदूतश् च प्रमथाः प्रीतिवर्धनाः ॥
1.82.m: Mahākarṇa, Prabhāta, crusher of mighty bhūtas, / Śyenajit, Śivadūta, the Pramathas who foster affection,

1.82.s:
koṭikoṭiśataiścaiva bhūtānāṃ mātaraḥ sadā
vyapohantu bhayaṃ pāpaṃ mahādevaprasādataḥ //
1.82.d:
कोटिकोटिशतैश्चैव भूतानां मातरः सदा
व्यपोहन्तु भयं पापं महादेवप्रसादतः ॥
1.82.m: and the mothers of the bhūtas by hundreds of millions— / may they constantly remove fear and sin by the grace of Mahādeva.

1.82.s:
śivadhyānaikasampanno himarāḍ aṃbusannibhaḥ
kundendusadṛśākāraḥ kuṃbhakundendubhūṣaṇaḥ //
1.82.d:
शिवध्यानैकसम्पन्नो हिमराड् अंबुसन्निभः
कुन्देन्दुसदृशाकारः कुंभकुन्देन्दुभूषणः ॥
1.82.m: Solely engrossed in meditating upon Śiva, resembling the king of snow and water, / with a form like the kunda flower and the moon, adorned with a pot, kunda flowers, and the moon,

1.82.s:
vaḍavānalaśatruryo vaḍavāmukhabhedanaḥ
catuṣpādasamāyuktaḥ kṣīroda iva pāṇḍuraḥ //
1.82.d:
वडवानलशत्रुर्यो वडवामुखभेदनः
चतुष्पादसमायुक्तः क्षीरोद इव पाण्डुरः ॥
1.82.m: the foe of the submarine fire who cleft the submarine mouth, / endowed with four feet, white as the milk ocean,

1.82.s:
rudraloke sthito nityaṃ rudraiḥ sārdhaṃ gaṇeśvaraiḥ
vṛṣendro viśvadhṛg devo viśvasya jagataḥ pitā //
1.82.d:
रुद्रलोके स्थितो नित्यं रुद्रैः सार्धं गणेश्वरैः
वृषेन्द्रो विश्वधृग् देवो विश्वस्य जगतः पिता ॥
1.82.m: dwelling eternally in the world of Rudra alongside the Rudras and the lords of the gaṇas, / the Lord of Bulls, the god who upholds all, the father of the universe,

1.82.s:
vṛto nandādibhir nityaṃ mātṛbhir makhamardanaḥ
śivārcanarato nityaṃ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
1.82.d:
वृतो नन्दादिभिर् नित्यं मातृभिर् मखमर्दनः
शिवार्चनरतो नित्यं स मे पापं व्यपोहतु ॥
1.82.m: ever surrounded by the mothers headed by Nandā, the destroyer of the sacrifice, / ever devoted to worshipping Śiva—may he remove my sin.

1.82.s:
gaṅgā mātā jaganmātā rudraloke vyavasthitā
śivabhaktā tu yā nandā sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
1.82.d:
गङ्गा माता जगन्माता रुद्रलोके व्यवस्थिता
शिवभक्ता तु या नन्दा सा मे पापं व्यपोहतु ॥
1.82.m: Mother Gaṅgā, the mother of the world, who dwells in the world of Rudra, / and Nandā who is devoted to Śiva—may she remove my sin.

1.82.s:
bhadrā bhadrapadā devī śivaloke vyavasthitā
mātā gavāṃ mahābhāgā sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
1.82.d:
भद्रा भद्रपदा देवी शिवलोके व्यवस्थिता
माता गवां महाभागा सा मे पापं व्यपोहतु ॥
1.82.m: The goddess Bhadrā, of auspicious steps, who dwells in the world of Śiva, / the fortunate mother of cows—may she remove my sin.

1.82.s:
surabhiḥ sarvatobhadrā sarvapāpapraṇāśanī
rudrapūjāratā nityaṃ sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
1.82.d:
सुरभिः सर्वतोभद्रा सर्वपापप्रणाशनी
रुद्रपूजारता नित्यं सा मे पापं व्यपोहतु ॥
1.82.m: Surabhi, auspicious on every side, destroyer of all sin, / ever devoted to the worship of Rudra—may she remove my sin.

1.82.s:
suśīlā śīlasampannā śrīpradā śivabhāvitā
śivaloke sthitā nityaṃ sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
1.82.d:
सुशीला शीलसम्पन्ना श्रीप्रदा शिवभाविता
शिवलोके स्थिता नित्यं सा मे पापं व्यपोहतु ॥
1.82.m: Suśīlā, richly endowed with good character, granter of prosperity, devoted to Śiva, / ever abiding in the world of Śiva—may she remove my sin.

1.82.s:
vedaśāstrārthatattvajñaḥ sarvakāryābhicintakaḥ
samastaguṇasampannaḥ sarvadeveśvarātmajaḥ //
1.82.d:
वेदशास्त्रार्थतत्त्वज्ञः सर्वकार्याभिचिन्तकः
समस्तगुणसम्पन्नः सर्वदेवेश्वरात्मजः ॥
1.82.m: Knower of the truth of the Veda and the scriptures, mindful of all tasks, / endowed with all virtues, son of the Lord of all gods,

1.82.s:
jyeṣṭhaḥ sarveśvaraḥ saumyo mahāviṣṇutanuḥ svayam
āryaḥ senāpatiḥ sākṣād gahano makhamardanaḥ //
1.82.d:
ज्येष्ठः सर्वेश्वरः सौम्यो महाविष्णुतनुः स्वयम्
आर्यः सेनापतिः साक्षाद् गहनो मखमर्दनः ॥
1.82.m: the Eldest, the Lord of all, gentle, the very embodiment of Mahāviṣṇu, / the noble one, commander of the army in person, unfathomable, destroyer of the sacrifice,

1.82.s:
airāvatagajārūḍhaḥ kṛṣṇakuñcitamūrdhajaḥ
kṛṣṇāṅgo raktanayanaḥ śaśipannagabhūṣaṇaḥ //
1.82.d:
ऐरावतगजारूढः कृष्णकुञ्चितमूर्धजः
कृष्णाङ्गो रक्तनयनः शशिपन्नगभूषणः ॥
1.82.m: mounted upon the elephant Airāvata, with black curled hair, / dark-bodied, red-eyed, adorned with the moon and serpents,

1.82.s:
bhūtaiḥ pretaiḥ piśācaiś ca kūṣmāṇḍaiś ca samāvṛtaḥ
śivārcanarataḥ sākṣāt sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
1.82.d:
भूतैः प्रेतैः पिशाचैश् च कूष्माण्डैश् च समावृतः
शिवार्चनरतः साक्षात् स मे पापं व्यपोहतु ॥
1.82.m: surrounded by bhūtas, pretas, piśācas, and kūṣmāṇḍas, / directly engaged in worshipping Śiva—may he remove my sin.

1.82.s:
brahmāṇī caiva māheśī kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathā
vārāhī caiva māhendrī cāmuṇḍāgneyikā tathā //
1.82.d:
ब्रह्माणी चैव माहेशी कौमारी वैष्णवी तथा
वाराही चैव माहेन्द्री चामुण्डाग्नेयिका तथा ॥
1.82.m: Brahmāṇī, Māheśī, Kaumārī, Vaiṣṇavī, / Vārāhī, Māhendrī, Cāmuṇḍā, and Āgneyī—

1.82.s:
etā vai mātaraḥ sarvāḥ sarvalokaprapūjitāḥ
yoginībhir mahāpāpaṃ vyapohantu samāhitāḥ //
1.82.d:
एता वै मातरः सर्वाः सर्वलोकप्रपूजिताः
योगिनीभिर् महापापं व्यपोहन्तु समाहिताः ॥
1.82.m: all these mothers, worshipped by all the worlds, / with their Yoginīs, intent on meditation, may they remove my great sin.

1.82.s:
vīrabhadro mahātejā himakundendusannibhaḥ
rudrasya tanayo raudraḥ śūlāsaktamahākaraḥ //
1.82.d:
वीरभद्रो महातेजा हिमकुन्देन्दुसन्निभः
रुद्रस्य तनयो रौद्रः शूलासक्तमहाकरः ॥
1.82.m: Vīrabhadra of great splendour, resembling snow, the kunda flower, and the moon, / the fierce son of Rudra, whose mighty hand grasps the trident,

1.82.s:
sahasrabāhuḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvāyudhadharaḥ svayam
tretāgninayano devas trailokyābhayadaḥ prabhuḥ //
1.82.d:
सहस्रबाहुः सर्वज्ञः सर्वायुधधरः स्वयम्
त्रेताग्निनयनो देवस् त्रैलोक्याभयदः प्रभुः ॥
1.82.m: thousand-armed, omniscient, bearing all weapons himself, / the god whose eyes are the three sacred fires, the lord who grants fearlessness to the three worlds,

1.82.s:
mātṝṇāṃ rakṣako nityaṃ mahāvṛṣabhavāhanaḥ
trailokyanamitaḥ śrīmān śivapādārcane rataḥ //
1.82.d:
मातॄणां रक्षको नित्यं महावृषभवाहनः
त्रैलोक्यनमितः श्रीमान् शिवपादार्चने रतः ॥
1.82.m: the constant protector of the mothers, whose mount is a great bull, / bowed to by the three worlds, glorious, devoted to worshipping the feet of Śiva,

1.82.s:
yajñasya ca śiraśchettā pūṣṇo dantavināśanaḥ
vahnerhastaharaḥ sākṣād bhaganetranipātanaḥ //
1.82.d:
यज्ञस्य च शिरश्छेत्ता पूष्णो दन्तविनाशनः
वह्नेर्हस्तहरः साक्षाद् भगनेत्रनिपातनः ॥
1.82.m: the severer of the head of the sacrifice, the destroyer of Pūṣan's teeth, / who severed the hands of Fire, who cast down the eyes of Bhaga,

1.82.s:
pādāṅguṣṭhena somāṅgapeṣakaḥ prabhusaṃjñakaḥ
upendrendrayamādīnāṃ devānāmaṅgarakṣakaḥ //
1.82.d:
पादाङ्गुष्ठेन सोमाङ्गपेषकः प्रभुसंज्ञकः
उपेन्द्रेन्द्रयमादीनां देवानामङ्गरक्षकः ॥
1.82.m: who crushed the limbs of the Moon with his big toe, called the Lord, / the body-protector of the gods beginning with Upendra, Indra, and Yama—

1.82.s:
sarasvatyā mahādevyā nāsikoṣṭhāvakartanaḥ
gaṇeśvaro yaḥ senānīḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
1.82.d:
सरस्वत्या महादेव्या नासिकोष्ठावकर्तनः
गणेश्वरो यः सेनानीः स मे पापं व्यपोहतु ॥
1.82.m: May the lord of the gaṇas, the commander of armies, who cut off the nose and lip of the great goddess Sarasvatī, / remove my sin.

1.82.s:
jyeṣṭhā variṣṭhā varadā varābharaṇabhūṣitā
mahālakṣmīrjaganmātā sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
1.82.d:
ज्येष्ठा वरिष्ठा वरदा वराभरणभूषिता
महालक्ष्मीर्जगन्माता सा मे पापं व्यपोहतु ॥
1.82.m: May the foremost, the most excellent, the grantor of boons, adorned with splendid ornaments, / Mahālakṣmī, the mother of the universe, remove my sin.

1.82.s:
mahāmohā mahābhāgā mahābhūtagaṇairvṛtā
śivārcanaratā nityaṃ sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
1.82.d:
महामोहा महाभागा महाभूतगणैर्वृता
शिवार्चनरता नित्यं सा मे पापं व्यपोहतु ॥
1.82.m: May she who is Great Delusion, highly fortunate, surrounded by hosts of great spirits, / ever devoted to the worship of Śiva, remove my sin.

1.82.s:
lakṣmīḥ sarvaguṇopetā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā
sarvadā sarvagā devī sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
1.82.d:
लक्ष्मीः सर्वगुणोपेता सर्वलक्षणसंयुता
सर्वदा सर्वगा देवी सा मे पापं व्यपोहतु ॥
1.82.m: May Lakṣmī, endowed with all auspicious qualities, possessing all auspicious marks, / the ever-giving, all-pervading goddess, remove my sin.

1.82.s:
siṃhārūḍhā mahādevī pārvatyāstanayāvyayā
viṣṇornidrā mahāmāyā vaiṣṇavī surapūjitā //
1.82.d:
सिंहारूढा महादेवी पार्वत्यास्तनयाव्यया
विष्णोर्निद्रा महामाया वैष्णवी सुरपूजिता ॥
1.82.m: Mounted upon a lion, the great goddess, the imperishable daughter of Pārvatī, / the slumber of Viṣṇu, Mahāmāyā, Vaiṣṇavī, worshipped by the gods,

1.82.s:
trinetrā varadā devī mahiṣāsuramardinī
śivārcanaratā durgā sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu //
1.82.d:
त्रिनेत्रा वरदा देवी महिषासुरमर्दिनी
शिवार्चनरता दुर्गा सा मे पापं व्यपोहतु ॥
1.82.m: three-eyed, grantor of boons, the goddess crusher of the demon Mahiṣa, / Durgā, devoted to the worship of Śiva—may she remove my sin.

1.82.s:
brahmāṇḍadhārakā rudrāḥ sarvalokaprapūjitāḥ
satyāś ca mānasāḥ sarve vyapohantu bhayaṃ mama //
1.82.d:
ब्रह्माण्डधारका रुद्राः सर्वलोकप्रपूजिताः
सत्याश् च मानसाः सर्वे व्यपोहन्तु भयं मम ॥
1.82.m: May the Rudras, upholders of the cosmic egg, revered by all worlds, / the Satyas, and all the mind-born [deities], remove my fear.

1.82.s:
bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāś ca kūṣmāṇḍagaṇanāyakāḥ
kūṣmāṇḍakāś ca te pāpaṃ vyapohantu samāhitāḥ //
1.82.d:
भूताः प्रेताः पिशाचाश् च कूष्माण्डगणनायकाः
कूष्माण्डकाश् च ते पापं व्यपोहन्तु समाहिताः ॥
1.82.m: May the bhūtas, pretas, piśācas, leaders of the kūṣmāṇḍa hosts, / and the kūṣmāṇḍas, composed in mind, remove your sin.

1.82.s:
anena devaṃ stutvā tu cānte sarvaṃ samāpayet
praṇamya śirasā bhūmau pratimāse dvijottamāḥ //
1.82.d:
अनेन देवं स्तुत्वा तु चान्ते सर्वं समापयेत्
प्रणम्य शिरसा भूमौ प्रतिमासे द्विजोत्तमाः ॥
1.82.m: Having praised the God with this [hymn], one should conclude everything at the end, / bowing one's head to the ground every month, O best of the twice-born.

1.82.s:
vyapohanastavaṃ divyaṃ yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādapi
vidhūya sarvapāpāni rudraloke mahīyate //
1.82.d:
व्यपोहनस्तवं दिव्यं यः पठेच्छृणुयादपि
विधूय सर्वपापानि रुद्रलोके महीयते ॥
1.82.m: Whoever recites or even listens to this divine Vyapohana hymn / shakes off all sins and is exalted in the realm of Rudra.

1.82.s:
kanyārthī labhate kanyāṃ jayakāmo jayaṃ labhet
arthakāmo labhedarthaṃ putrakāmo bahūn sutān //
1.82.d:
कन्यार्थी लभते कन्यां जयकामो जयं लभेत्
अर्थकामो लभेदर्थं पुत्रकामो बहून् सुतान् ॥
1.82.m: One who desires a maiden obtains a maiden; one who seeks victory obtains victory; / one who desires wealth obtains wealth; one who desires a son obtains many sons.

1.82.s:
vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ bhogārthī bhogamāpnuyāt
yānyānprārthayate kāmān mānavaḥ śravaṇādiha //
1.82.d:
विद्यार्थी लभते विद्यां भोगार्थी भोगमाप्नुयात्
यान्यान्प्रार्थयते कामान् मानवः श्रवणादिह ॥
1.82.m: One who desires learning obtains learning; one who seeks enjoyment attains enjoyment; / whatever desires a mortal asks for here from hearing it,

1.82.s:
tānsarvān śīghramāpnoti devānāṃ ca priyo bhavet
paṭhyamānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ yamuddiśya tu paṭhyate //
1.82.d:
तान्सर्वान् शीघ्रमाप्नोति देवानां च प्रियो भवेत्
पठ्यमानमिदं पुण्यं यमुद्दिश्य तु पठ्यते ॥
1.82.m: all those he attains swiftly, and he becomes dear to the gods. / When this meritorious [hymn] is recited, for whoever's sake it is recited,

1.82.s:
tasya rogā na bādhante vātapittādisaṃbhavāḥ
nākāle maraṇaṃ tasya na sarpairapi daśyate //
1.82.d:
तस्य रोगा न बाधन्ते वातपित्तादिसंभवाः
नाकाले मरणं तस्य न सर्पैरपि दश्यते ॥
1.82.m: diseases arising from wind, bile, and the like do not torment him; / untimely death is not his, nor is he bitten by serpents.

1.82.s:
yatpuṇyaṃ caiva tīrthānāṃ yajñānāṃ caiva yatphalam
dānānāṃ caiva yatpuṇyaṃ vratānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ //
1.82.d:
यत्पुण्यं चैव तीर्थानां यज्ञानां चैव यत्फलम्
दानानां चैव यत्पुण्यं व्रतानां च विशेषतः ॥
1.82.m: Whatever merit comes from sacred fords, whatever fruit from sacrifices, / whatever merit comes from gifts, and especially from religious observances,

1.82.s:
tatpuṇyaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ japtvā cāpnoti mānavaḥ
goghnaścaiva kṛtaghnaś ca vīrahā brahmahā bhavet //
1.82.d:
तत्पुण्यं कोटिगुणितं जप्त्वा चाप्नोति मानवः
गोघ्नश्चैव कृतघ्नश् च वीरहा ब्रह्महा भवेत् ॥
1.82.m: a person attains that merit multiplied ten million times by reciting [this]. / Even if one is a killer of cows, ungrateful, a slayer of heroes, or a slayer of a brāhmaṇa,

1.82.s:
śaraṇāgataghātī ca mitraviśvāsaghātakaḥ
duṣṭaḥ pāpasamācāro mātṛhā pitṛhā tathā //
1.82.d:
शरणागतघाती च मित्रविश्वासघातकः
दुष्टः पापसमाचारो मातृहा पितृहा तथा ॥
1.82.m: a slayer of those who sought refuge, a betrayer of friends' trust, / wicked, sinful in conduct, a killer of a mother or a father,

1.82.s: vyapohya sarvapāpāni śivaloke mahīyate //
1.82.d: व्यपोह्य सर्वपापानि शिवलोके महीयते ॥
1.82.m: having dispelled all sins, he is exalted in the realm of Śiva.

1.83.s:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
vyapohanastavaṃ puṇyaṃ śrutamasmābhir ādarāt
prasaṃgālliṅgadānasya vratānyapi vadasva naḥ //
1.83.d:
ऋषय ऊचुः
व्यपोहनस्तवं पुण्यं श्रुतमस्माभिर् आदरात्
प्रसंगाल्लिङ्गदानस्य व्रतान्यपि वदस्व नः ॥
1.83.m: The sages said: / We have attentively heard the sacred Vyapohana hymn. / In connection with the gift of a liṅga, tell us also about the religious observances.

1.83.s:
sūta uvāca
vratāni vaḥ pravakṣyāmi śubhāni munisattamāḥ
nandinā kathitānīha brahmaputrāya dhīmate //
1.83.d:
सूत उवाच
व्रतानि वः प्रवक्ष्यामि शुभानि मुनिसत्तमाः
नन्दिना कथितानीह ब्रह्मपुत्राय धीमते ॥
1.83.m: Sūta said: / I will declare to you, O best of sages, the auspicious observances / related here by Nandin to the wise son of Brahmā.

1.83.s:
tāni vyāsādupaśrutya yuṣmākaṃ pravadāmyaham
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi //
1.83.d:
तानि व्यासादुपश्रुत्य युष्माकं प्रवदाम्यहम्
अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यां पक्षयोरुभयोरपि ॥
1.83.m: Having heard them from Vyāsa, I declare them to you. / On the eighth and fourteenth days of both fortnights,

1.83.s:
varṣamekaṃ tu bhuñjāno naktaṃ yaḥ pūjayecchivam
sarvayajñaphalaṃ prāpya sa yāti paramāṃ gatim //
1.83.d:
वर्षमेकं तु भुञ्जानो नक्तं यः पूजयेच्छिवम्
सर्वयज्ञफलं प्राप्य स याति परमां गतिम् ॥
1.83.m: eating only at night for one year, whoever worships Śiva / attains the fruit of all sacrifices and goes to the supreme state.

1.83.s:
pṛthivīṃ bhājanaṃ kṛtvā bhuktvā parvasu mānavaḥ
ahorātreṇa caikena trirātraphalamaśnute //
1.83.d:
पृथिवीं भाजनं कृत्वा भुक्त्वा पर्वसु मानवः
अहोरात्रेण चैकेन त्रिरात्रफलमश्नुते ॥
1.83.m: A person who, using the ground as a plate, eats on the sacred junction-days, / enjoys the fruit of a three-night fast by means of a single day and night.

1.83.s:
dvayor māsasya pañcamyor dvayoḥ pratipadornaraḥ
kṣīradhārāvrataṃ kuryāt so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet //
1.83.d:
द्वयोर् मासस्य पञ्चम्योर् द्वयोः प्रतिपदोर्नरः
क्षीरधाराव्रतं कुर्यात् सो ऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् ॥
1.83.m: If a man performs the stream-of-milk observance on both fifth days and both first days of the month, / he attains the fruit of a horse sacrifice.

1.83.s:
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ tu naktena yāvatkṛṣṇacaturdaśī
bhuñjanbhogānavāpnoti brahmalokaṃ ca gacchati //
1.83.d:
कृष्णाष्टम्यां तु नक्तेन यावत्कृष्णचतुर्दशी
भुञ्जन्भोगानवाप्नोति ब्रह्मलोकं च गच्छति ॥
1.83.m: Eating only at night from the dark eighth until the dark fourteenth, / he attains enjoyments and goes to the world of Brahmā.

1.83.s:
yo 'bdamekaṃ prakurvīta naktaṃ parvasu parvasu
brahmacārī jitakrodhaḥ śivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ //
1.83.d:
यो ऽब्दमेकं प्रकुर्वीत नक्तं पर्वसु पर्वसु
ब्रह्मचारी जितक्रोधः शिवध्यानपरायणः ॥
1.83.m: One who observes a night meal on every sacred junction-day for one year, / chaste, with anger subdued, devoted to meditation on Śiva,

1.83.s:
saṃvatsarānte viprendrān bhojayedvidhipūrvakam
sa yāti śāṅkaraṃ lokaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā //
1.83.d:
संवत्सरान्ते विप्रेन्द्रान् भोजयेद्विधिपूर्वकम्
स याति शाङ्करं लोकं नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
1.83.m: should feed eminent brāhmaṇas according to rule at the end of the year; / he goes to the realm of Śaṅkara—there is no doubt about this.

1.83.s:
upavāsāt paraṃ bhaikṣyaṃ bhaikṣyāt param ayācitam
ayācitāt paraṃ naktaṃ tasmān naktena vartayet //
1.83.d:
उपवासात् परं भैक्ष्यं भैक्ष्यात् परम् अयाचितम्
अयाचितात् परं नक्तं तस्मान् नक्तेन वर्तयेत् ॥
1.83.m: Better than fasting is begged food; better than begged food is unsolicited food; / better than unsolicited food is eating at night: therefore one should subsist by night eating.

1.83.s:
devairbhuktaṃ tu pūrvāhṇe madhyāhne ṛṣibhis tathā
aparāhṇe ca pitṛbhiḥ saṃdhyāyāṃ guhyakādibhiḥ //
1.83.d:
देवैर्भुक्तं तु पूर्वाह्णे मध्याह्ने ऋषिभिस् तथा
अपराह्णे च पितृभिः संध्यायां गुह्यकादिभिः ॥
1.83.m: Food is eaten by the gods in the forenoon, by the sages at midday, / by the ancestors in the afternoon, and by the guhyakas and others at twilight.

1.83.s:
sarvavelāmatikramya naktabhojanamuttamam
haviṣyabhojanaṃ snānaṃ satyamāhāralāghavam //
1.83.d:
सर्ववेलामतिक्रम्य नक्तभोजनमुत्तमम्
हविष्यभोजनं स्नानं सत्यमाहारलाघवम् ॥
1.83.m: Surpassing all times, the night meal is supreme. / Eating sacrificial food, bathing, truthfulness, lightness of food,

1.83.s:
agnikāryamadhaḥśayyāṃ naktabhojī samācaret
pratimāsaṃ pravakṣyāmi śivavratamanuttamam //
1.83.d:
अग्निकार्यमधःशय्यां नक्तभोजी समाचरेत्
प्रतिमासं प्रवक्ष्यामि शिवव्रतमनुत्तमम् ॥
1.83.m: fire ritual, and sleeping on the ground—one who eats at night should practise [these]. / I shall declare the peerless observance of Śiva month by month,

1.83.s:
dharmakāmārthamokṣārthaṃ sarvapāpaviśuddhaye
puṣyamāse ca sampūjya yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam //
1.83.d:
धर्मकामार्थमोक्षार्थं सर्वपापविशुद्धये
पुष्यमासे च सम्पूज्य यः कुर्यान्नक्तभोजनम् ॥
1.83.m: for the sake of dharma, kāma, artha, and liberation, and for purification from all sins. / In the month of Puṣya, having worshipped and eating only at night,

1.83.s:
satyavādī jitakrodhaḥ śāligodhūmagorasaiḥ
pakṣayoraṣṭamīṃ yatnād upavāsena vartayet //
1.83.d:
सत्यवादी जितक्रोधः शालिगोधूमगोरसैः
पक्षयोरष्टमीं यत्नाद् उपवासेन वर्तयेत् ॥
1.83.m: truth-speaking, anger subdued, [subsisting on] winter rice, wheat, and cow's milk products, / one should diligently observe a fast on the eighth day of both fortnights.

1.83.s:
bhūmiśayyāṃ ca māsānte paurṇamāsyāṃ ghṛtādibhiḥ
snāpya rudraṃ mahādevaṃ sampūjya vidhipūrvakam //
1.83.d:
भूमिशय्यां च मासान्ते पौर्णमास्यां घृतादिभिः
स्नाप्य रुद्रं महादेवं सम्पूज्य विधिपूर्वकम् ॥
1.83.m: Sleeping on the ground, and at the end of the month, on the full moon day, / having bathed Rudra, Mahādeva, with ghee and other substances and worshipped him according to rule,

1.83.s:
yāvakaṃ caudanaṃ dattvā sakṣīraṃ saghṛtaṃ dvijāḥ
bhojayed brāhmaṇāñśiṣṭāñ japecchāntiṃ viśeṣataḥ //
1.83.d:
यावकं चौदनं दत्त्वा सक्षीरं सघृतं द्विजाः
भोजयेद् ब्राह्मणाञ्शिष्टाञ् जपेच्छान्तिं विशेषतः ॥
1.83.m: offering barley porridge and boiled rice with milk and ghee, O twice-born, / one should feed cultivated brāhmaṇas and especially recite the peace chant.

1.83.s:
tathā gomithunaṃ caiva kapilaṃ vinivedayet
bhavāya devadevāya śivāya parameṣṭhine //
1.83.d:
तथा गोमिथुनं चैव कपिलं विनिवेदयेत्
भवाय देवदेवाय शिवाय परमेष्ठिने ॥
1.83.m: Likewise, one should present a pair of tawny cattle / to Bhava, the God of gods, Śiva, the Supreme Lord.

1.83.s:
sa yāti muniśārdūla vāhneyaṃ lokamuttamam
bhuktvā sa vipulān lokān tatraiva sa vimucyate //
1.83.d:
स याति मुनिशार्दूल वाह्नेयं लोकमुत्तमम्
भुक्त्वा स विपुलान् लोकान् तत्रैव स विमुच्यते ॥
1.83.m: He goes, O tiger among sages, to the excellent world of Agni; / having enjoyed vast worlds, he is liberated right there.

1.83.s:
māghamāse tu sampūjya yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam
kṛśaraṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ bhuñjānaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ //
1.83.d:
माघमासे तु सम्पूज्य यः कुर्यान् नक्तभोजनम्
कृशरं घृतसंयुक्तं भुञ्जानः संयतेन्द्रियः ॥
1.83.m: In the month of Māgha, having worshipped, one who eats only at night, / consuming khichdi mixed with ghee, with senses subdued,

1.83.s:
sopavāsaṃ caturdaśyāṃ bhavedubhayapakṣayoḥ
rudrāya paurṇamāsyāṃ tu dadyādvai ghṛtakambalam //
1.83.d:
सोपवासं चतुर्दश्यां भवेदुभयपक्षयोः
रुद्राय पौर्णमास्यां तु दद्याद्वै घृतकम्बलम् ॥
1.83.m: should observe a fast on the fourteenth day of both fortnights; / and on the full moon day, one should offer a blanket of ghee to Rudra.

1.83.s:
kṛṣṇaṃ gomithunaṃ dadyāt pūjayeccaiva śaṃkaram
bhojayedbrāhmaṇāṃścaiva yathāvibhavavistaram //
1.83.d:
कृष्णं गोमिथुनं दद्यात् पूजयेच्चैव शंकरम्
भोजयेद्ब्राह्मणांश्चैव यथाविभवविस्तरम् ॥
1.83.m: One should give a pair of black cattle and worship Śaṅkara, / and feed brāhmaṇas according to the extent of one's wealth.

1.83.s:
yāmyamāsādya vai lokaṃ yamena saha modate
phālgune caiva samprāpte kuryādvai naktabhojanam //
1.83.d:
याम्यमासाद्य वै लोकं यमेन सह मोदते
फाल्गुने चैव सम्प्राप्ते कुर्याद्वै नक्तभोजनम् ॥
1.83.m: Reaching the realm of Yama, he rejoices with Yama. / When Phālguna arrives, one should eat only at night,

1.83.s:
śyāmākānnaghṛtakṣīrair jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ
caturdaśyāmathāṣṭamyām upavāsaṃ ca kārayet //
1.83.d:
श्यामाकान्नघृतक्षीरैर् जितक्रोधो जितेन्द्रियः
चतुर्दश्यामथाष्टम्याम् उपवासं च कारयेत् ॥
1.83.m: with wild millet grains, ghee, and milk, with anger and senses subdued, / and should undertake a fast on the fourteenth or the eighth.

1.83.s:
paurṇamāsyāṃ mahādevaṃ snāpya sampūjya śaṅkaram
dadyādgomithunaṃ vāpi tāmrābhaṃ śūlapāṇaye //
1.83.d:
पौर्णमास्यां महादेवं स्नाप्य सम्पूज्य शङ्करम्
दद्याद्गोमिथुनं वापि ताम्राभं शूलपाणये ॥
1.83.m: On the full moon day, having bathed and worshipped Mahādeva, Śaṅkara, / one should give a pair of copper-coloured cattle to the Trident-bearer.

1.83.s:
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tu prārthayetparameśvaram
sa yāti candrasāyujyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā //
1.83.d:
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा तु प्रार्थयेत्परमेश्वरम्
स याति चन्द्रसायुज्यं नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
1.83.m: Having fed brāhmaṇas, he should pray to the Supreme Lord; / he attains union with the Moon—there is no doubt about this.

1.83.s:
caitre 'pi rudramabhyarcya kuryādvai naktabhojanam
śālyannaṃ payasā yuktaṃ ghṛtena ca yathāsukham //
1.83.d:
चैत्रे ऽपि रुद्रमभ्यर्च्य कुर्याद्वै नक्तभोजनम्
शाल्यन्नं पयसा युक्तं घृतेन च यथासुखम् ॥
1.83.m: In Caitra as well, having worshipped Rudra, one should eat only at night / rice from winter grain mixed with milk and ghee at pleasure.

1.83.s:
goṣṭhaśāyī muniśreṣṭhāḥ kṣitau niśi bhavaṃ smaret
paurṇamāsyāṃ śivaṃ snāpya dadyādgomithunaṃ sitam //
1.83.d:
गोष्ठशायी मुनिश्रेष्ठाः क्षितौ निशि भवं स्मरेत्
पौर्णमास्यां शिवं स्नाप्य दद्याद्गोमिथुनं सितम् ॥
1.83.m: Sleeping in a cow-pen on the ground, O best of sages, one should remember Bhava at night; / on the full moon day, having bathed Śiva, one should give a pair of white cattle,

1.83.s:
brāhmaṇān bhojayeccaiva nirṛteḥ sthānamāpnuyāt
vaiśākhe ca tathā māse kṛtvā vai naktabhojanam //
1.83.d:
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयेच्चैव निरृतेः स्थानमाप्नुयात्
वैशाखे च तथा मासे कृत्वा वै नक्तभोजनम् ॥
1.83.m: and feed brāhmaṇas; he attains the abode of Nirṛti. / Likewise, in the month of Vaiśākha, having eaten only at night,

1.83.s:
paurṇamāsyāṃ bhavaṃ snāpya pañcagavyaghṛtādibhiḥ
śvetaṃ gomithunaṃ dattvā so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet //
1.83.d:
पौर्णमास्यां भवं स्नाप्य पञ्चगव्यघृतादिभिः
श्वेतं गोमिथुनं दत्त्वा सो ऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् ॥
1.83.m: bathing Bhava on the full moon day with the five products of the cow, ghee, and other liquids, / and giving a pair of white cattle, he obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice.

1.83.s:
jyeṣṭhe māse ca deveśaṃ bhavaṃ śarvamumāpatim
sampūjya śraddhayā bhaktyā kṛtvā vai naktabhojanam //
1.83.d:
ज्येष्ठे मासे च देवेशं भवं शर्वमुमापतिम्
सम्पूज्य श्रद्धया भक्त्या कृत्वा वै नक्तभोजनम् ॥
1.83.m: And in the month of Jyeṣṭha, having worshipped the lord of the gods, Bhava, Śarva, the lord of Umā, / with faith and devotion, and having eaten only at night,

1.83.s:
raktaśālyannamadhvā ca adbhiḥ pūtaṃ ghṛtādibhiḥ
vīrāsano niśārdhaṃ ca gavāṃ śuśrūṣaṇe rataḥ //
1.83.d:
रक्तशाल्यन्नमध्वा च अद्भिः पूतं घृतादिभिः
वीरासनो निशार्धं च गवां शुश्रूषणे रतः ॥
1.83.m: [eating] red rice and honey, purified with water and ghee, / sitting in the hero's posture for half the night and devoted to tending cows,

1.83.s:
paurṇamāsyāṃ tu sampūjya devadevamumāpatim
snāpya śaktyā yathānyāyaṃ caruṃ dadyāc ca śūline //
1.83.d:
पौर्णमास्यां तु सम्पूज्य देवदेवमुमापतिम्
स्नाप्य शक्त्या यथान्यायं चरुं दद्याच् च शूलिने ॥
1.83.m: and having worshipped the god of gods, the lord of Umā, on the full moon day, / having bathed [him] according to rule to the best of one's ability, one should offer the sacred boiled offering to the Trident-bearer.

1.83.s:
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca yathāvibhavavistaram
dhūmraṃ gomithunaṃ dattvā vāyuloke mahīyate //
1.83.d:
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च यथाविभवविस्तरम्
धूम्रं गोमिथुनं दत्त्वा वायुलोके महीयते ॥
1.83.m: And having fed Brahmins according to the extent of one's wealth, / and having given a smoke-coloured pair of cattle, one is honoured in the world of Vāyu.

1.83.s:
āṣāḍhe māsi cāpyevaṃ naktabhojanatatparaḥ
bhūrikhaṇḍājyasaṃmiśraṃ saktubhiścaiva gorasam //
1.83.d:
आषाढे मासि चाप्येवं नक्तभोजनतत्परः
भूरिखण्डाज्यसंमिश्रं सक्तुभिश्चैव गोरसम् ॥
1.83.m: And in the month of Āṣāḍha likewise, intent on eating only at night, / [eating] milk and milk-products mixed with roasted barley flour, abundant raw sugar, and ghee,

1.83.s:
paurṇamāsyāṃ ghṛtādyaistu snāpya pūjya yathāvidhi
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca śrotriyān vedapāragān //
1.83.d:
पौर्णमास्यां घृताद्यैस्तु स्नाप्य पूज्य यथाविधि
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च श्रोत्रियान् वेदपारगान् ॥
1.83.m: having bathed and worshipped [him] on the full moon day according to rule with ghee and the like, / and having fed Brahmins learned in the Vedas and masters of the Vedas,

1.83.s:
dadyādgomithunaṃ gauraṃ vāruṇaṃ lokamāpnuyāt
śrāvaṇe ca dvijā māse kṛtvā vai naktabhojanam //
1.83.d:
दद्याद्गोमिथुनं गौरं वारुणं लोकमाप्नुयात्
श्रावणे च द्विजा मासे कृत्वा वै नक्तभोजनम् ॥
1.83.m: one should give a fair-coloured pair of cattle; one attains the world of Varuṇa. / And in the month of Śrāvaṇa, O twice-born ones, having eaten only at night,

1.83.s:
kṣīraṣaṣṭikabhaktena sampūjya vṛṣabhadhvajam
paurṇamāsyāṃ ghṛtādyaistu snāpya pūjya yathāvidhi //
1.83.d:
क्षीरषष्टिकभक्तेन सम्पूज्य वृषभध्वजम्
पौर्णमास्यां घृताद्यैस्तु स्नाप्य पूज्य यथाविधि ॥
1.83.m: having worshipped him who has a bull on his banner with cooked sixty-day rice in milk, / and on the full moon day having bathed and worshipped [him] according to rule with ghee and the like,

1.83.s:
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca śrotriyān vedapāragān
śvetāgrapādaṃ pauṇḍraṃ ca dadyādgomithunaṃ punaḥ //
1.83.d:
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च श्रोत्रियान् वेदपारगान्
श्वेताग्रपादं पौण्ड्रं च दद्याद्गोमिथुनं पुनः ॥
1.83.m: and having fed Brahmins learned in the Vedas and masters of the Vedas, / one should then give a pair of cattle, pauṇḍra [in breed] with white forefeet.

1.83.s:
sa yāti vāyusāyujyaṃ vāyuvatsarvago bhavet
prāpte bhādrapade māse kṛtvaivaṃ naktabhojanam //
1.83.d:
स याति वायुसायुज्यं वायुवत्सर्वगो भवेत्
प्राप्ते भाद्रपदे मासे कृत्वैवं नक्तभोजनम् ॥
1.83.m: He goes to union with Vāyu and becomes all-pervading like Vāyu. / When the month of Bhādrapada has arrived, having thus eaten only at night,

1.83.s:
hutaśeṣaṃ ca viprendrān vṛkṣamūlāśrito divā
paurṇamāsyāṃ tu deveśaṃ snāpya sampūjya śaṅkaram //
1.83.d:
हुतशेषं च विप्रेन्द्रान् वृक्षमूलाश्रितो दिवा
पौर्णमास्यां तु देवेशं स्नाप्य सम्पूज्य शङ्करम् ॥
1.83.m: [eating] the remnants of the oblation, O best of Brahmins, dwelling at the root of a tree by day, / and on the full moon day having bathed and worshipped Śaṅkara, the lord of the gods,

1.83.s:
nīlaskandhaṃ vṛṣaṃ gāṃ ca dattvā bhaktyā yathāvidhi
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca vedavedāṅgapāragān //
1.83.d:
नीलस्कन्धं वृषं गां च दत्त्वा भक्त्या यथाविधि
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च वेदवेदाङ्गपारगान् ॥
1.83.m: having given with devotion according to rule a blue-shouldered bull and a cow, / and having fed Brahmins who have mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas,

1.83.s:
yakṣalokamanuprāpya yakṣarājo bhavennaraḥ
tataścāśvayuje māsi kṛtvaivaṃ naktabhojanam //
1.83.d:
यक्षलोकमनुप्राप्य यक्षराजो भवेन्नरः
ततश्चाश्वयुजे मासि कृत्वैवं नक्तभोजनम् ॥
1.83.m: having reached the world of the Yakṣas, a man becomes a Yakṣa king. / Then in the month of Āśvayuja, having thus eaten only at night,

1.83.s:
saghṛtaṃ śaṅkaraṃ pūjya paurṇamāsyāṃ ca pūrvavat
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca śivabhaktān sadā śucīn //
1.83.d:
सघृतं शङ्करं पूज्य पौर्णमास्यां च पूर्ववत्
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च शिवभक्तान् सदा शुचीन् ॥
1.83.m: having worshipped Śaṅkara with ghee and on the full moon day as before, / and having fed Brahmins who are devotees of Śiva, always pure,

1.83.s:
vṛṣabhaṃ nīlavarṇābham urodeśasamunnatam
gāṃ ca dattvā yathānyāyam aiśānaṃ lokamāpnuyāt //
1.83.d:
वृषभं नीलवर्णाभम् उरोदेशसमुन्नतम्
गां च दत्त्वा यथान्यायम् ऐशानं लोकमाप्नुयात् ॥
1.83.m: and having given according to rule a bull having the appearance of a dark colour, / with an elevated chest, and a cow, one attains the world of Īśāna.

1.83.s:
kārtike ca tathā māse kṛtvā vai naktabhojanam
kṣīraudanena sājyena sampūjya ca bhavaṃ prabhum //
1.83.d:
कार्तिके च तथा मासे कृत्वा वै नक्तभोजनम्
क्षीरौदनेन साज्येन सम्पूज्य च भवं प्रभुम् ॥
1.83.m: And in the month of Kārtika likewise, having eaten only at night, / and having worshipped Lord Bhava with rice cooked in milk with ghee,

1.83.s:
paurṇamāsyāṃ ca vidhivat snāpya dattvā caruṃ punaḥ
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca yathāvibhavavistaram //
1.83.d:
पौर्णमास्यां च विधिवत् स्नाप्य दत्त्वा चरुं पुनः
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च यथाविभवविस्तरम् ॥
1.83.m: and on the full moon day having bathed [him] according to rule and offered the sacred boiled offering again, / and having fed Brahmins according to the extent of one's wealth,

1.83.s:
dattvā gomithunaṃ caiva kāpilaṃ pūrvavad dvijāḥ
sūryasāyujyamāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā //
1.83.d:
दत्त्वा गोमिथुनं चैव कापिलं पूर्ववद् द्विजाः
सूर्यसायुज्यमाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
1.83.m: and having given a pair of tawny cattle as before, O twice-born ones, / one attains union with Sūrya; no doubt should be entertained here.

1.83.s:
mārgaśīrṣe ca māse 'pi kṛtvaivaṃ naktabhojanam
yavānnena yathānyāyam ājyakṣīrādibhiḥ samam //
1.83.d:
मार्गशीर्षे च मासे ऽपि कृत्वैवं नक्तभोजनम्
यवान्नेन यथान्यायम् आज्यक्षीरादिभिः समम् ॥
1.83.m: And in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa also, having thus eaten only at night, / [subsisting] according to rule on barley-food along with ghee, milk, and the like,

1.83.s:
paurṇamāsyāṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ kṛtvā śarvāya śaṃbhave
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca daridrānvedapāragān //
1.83.d:
पौर्णमास्यां च पूर्वोक्तं कृत्वा शर्वाय शंभवे
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च दरिद्रान्वेदपारगान् ॥
1.83.m: and having performed on the full moon day what was previously spoken of for Śarva, Śambhu, / and having fed poor Brahmins who have mastered the Vedas,

1.83.s:
dattvā gomithunaṃ caiva pāṇḍuraṃ vidhipūrvakam
somalokamanuprāpya somena saha modate //
1.83.d:
दत्त्वा गोमिथुनं चैव पाण्डुरं विधिपूर्वकम्
सोमलोकमनुप्राप्य सोमेन सह मोदते ॥
1.83.m: and having given a pale pair of cattle according to rule, / having reached the world of Soma, one rejoices with Soma.

1.83.s:
ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryaṃ kṣamā dayā
triḥsnānaṃ cāgnihotraṃ ca bhūśayyā naktabhojanam //
1.83.d:
अहिंसा सत्यमस्तेयं ब्रह्मचर्यं क्षमा दया
त्रिःस्नानं चाग्निहोत्रं च भूशय्या नक्तभोजनम् ॥
1.83.m: Non-violence, truth, non-stealing, celibacy, forgiveness, compassion, / bathing three times a day, performing the Agnihotra fire-offering, sleeping on the ground, eating only at night,

1.83.s: pakṣayorupavāsaṃ ca caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca //
1.83.d: पक्षयोरुपवासं च चतुर्दश्यष्टमीषु च ॥
1.83.m: and fasting during the fortnights on the fourteenth and eighth [lunar days]—

1.83.s: ityetadakhilaṃ proktaṃ pratimāsaṃ śivavratam //
1.83.d: इत्येतदखिलं प्रोक्तं प्रतिमासं शिवव्रतम् ॥
1.83.m: all this has been spoken of as the monthly Śiva-vow.

1.83.s:
kuryādvarṣaṃ krameṇaiva vyutkrameṇāpi vā dvijāḥ
sa yāti śivasāyujyaṃ jñānayogamavāpnuyāt //
1.83.d:
कुर्याद्वर्षं क्रमेणैव व्युत्क्रमेणापि वा द्विजाः
स याति शिवसायुज्यं ज्ञानयोगमवाप्नुयात् ॥
1.83.m: One should observe it for a year in regular order, or even in reverse order, O twice-born ones; / he goes to union with Śiva and attains the yoga of knowledge.

1.84.s:
sūta uvāca
umāmaheśvaraṃ vakṣye vratamīśvarabhāṣitam
naranāryādijantūnāṃ hitāya munisattamāḥ //
1.84.d:
सूत उवाच
उमामहेश्वरं वक्ष्ये व्रतमीश्वरभाषितम्
नरनार्यादिजन्तूनां हिताय मुनिसत्तमाः ॥
1.84.m: Sūta said: / I shall declare the Umā-Maheśvara vow spoken by the Lord / for the welfare of men, women, and other living beings, O best of sages.

1.84.s:
paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāṃ caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca
naktamabdaṃ prakurvīta haviṣyaṃ pūjayedbhavam //
1.84.d:
पौर्णमास्याममावास्यां चतुर्दश्यष्टमीषु च
नक्तमब्दं प्रकुर्वीत हविष्यं पूजयेद्भवम् ॥
1.84.m: On the full moon, new moon, fourteenth, and eighth [lunar days], / one should eat sacrificial food at night for a year and worship Bhava.

1.84.s:
umāmaheśapratimāṃ hemnā kṛtvā suśobhanām
rājatīṃ vātha varṣānte pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi //
1.84.d:
उमामहेशप्रतिमां हेम्ना कृत्वा सुशोभनाम्
राजतीं वाथ वर्षान्ते प्रतिष्ठाप्य यथाविधि ॥
1.84.m: Having fashioned a very beautiful image of Umā and Maheśa out of gold / or silver, and having consecrated it according to rule at the end of the year,

1.84.s:
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca dattvā śaktyā ca dakṣiṇām
rathādyairvāpi deveśaṃ nītvā rudrālayaṃ prati //
1.84.d:
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च दत्त्वा शक्त्या च दक्षिणाम्
रथाद्यैर्वापि देवेशं नीत्वा रुद्रालयं प्रति ॥
1.84.m: and having fed Brahmins and given a priestly fee according to one's ability, / or having conveyed the lord of the gods to an abode of Rudra by chariots and the like,

1.84.s:
sarvātiśayasaṃyuktaiś chatracāmarabhūṣaṇaiḥ
nivedayedvrataṃ caiva śivāya parameṣṭhine //
1.84.d:
सर्वातिशयसंयुक्तैश् छत्रचामरभूषणैः
निवेदयेद्व्रतं चैव शिवाय परमेष्ठिने ॥
1.84.m: with parasols, chowries, and ornaments endowed with all excellences, / one should dedicate the vow to Śiva, the Supreme Lord.

1.84.s:
sa yāti śivasāyujyaṃ nārī devyā yadi prabho
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ niyatā brahmacāriṇī //
1.84.d:
स याति शिवसायुज्यं नारी देव्या यदि प्रभो
अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यां नियता ब्रह्मचारिणी ॥
1.84.m: He goes to union with Śiva; and a woman [attains union] with the Goddess, O lord, / if, restrained and celibate on the eighth and fourteenth [lunar days],

1.84.s:
varṣamekaṃ na bhuñjati kanyā vā vidhavāpi vā
varṣānte pratimāṃ kṛtvā pūrvoktavidhinā tataḥ //
1.84.d:
वर्षमेकं न भुञ्जति कन्या वा विधवापि वा
वर्षान्ते प्रतिमां कृत्वा पूर्वोक्तविधिना ततः ॥
1.84.m: she does not eat for one year, whether she is a maiden or a widow. / Having fashioned an image at the end of the year according to the rule previously stated, then

1.84.s:
pratiṣṭhāpya yathānyāyaṃ dattvā rudrālaye punaḥ
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca bhavānyā saha modate //
1.84.d:
प्रतिष्ठाप्य यथान्यायं दत्त्वा रुद्रालये पुनः
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च भवान्या सह मोदते ॥
1.84.m: having consecrated it according to rule and presented it in an abode of Rudra, / and having fed Brahmins, she rejoices with Bhavānī.

1.84.s:
yā nāryevaṃ caredabdaṃ kṛṣṇāmekāṃ caturdaśīm
varṣānte pratimāṃ kṛtvā yena kenāpi vā dvijāḥ //
1.84.d:
या नार्येवं चरेदब्दं कृष्णामेकां चतुर्दशीम्
वर्षान्ते प्रतिमां कृत्वा येन केनापि वा द्विजाः ॥
1.84.m: The woman who would observe thus for a year on each single dark fourteenth [lunar day], / and having fashioned an image at the end of the year out of whatever [she can], O twice-born ones,

1.84.s:
pūrvoktamakhilaṃ kṛtvā bhavānyā saha modate
amāvāsyāṃ nirāhārā bhavedabdaṃ suyantritā //
1.84.d:
पूर्वोक्तमखिलं कृत्वा भवान्या सह मोदते
अमावास्यां निराहारा भवेदब्दं सुयन्त्रिता ॥
1.84.m: and having done all that was previously stated, rejoices with Bhavānī. / Well-disciplined, she should be without food on the new moon for a year,

1.84.s:
śūlaṃ ca vidhinā kṛtvā varṣānte vinivedayet
snāpyeśānaṃ yajedbhaktyā sahasraiḥ kamalaiḥ sitaiḥ //
1.84.d:
शूलं च विधिना कृत्वा वर्षान्ते विनिवेदयेत्
स्नाप्येशानं यजेद्भक्त्या सहस्रैः कमलैः सितैः ॥
1.84.m: and having fashioned a trident according to rule, she should present it at the end of the year; / having bathed Īśāna, she should worship him with devotion with thousands of white lotuses.

1.84.s:
rājataṃ kamalaṃ caiva jāṃbūnadasukarṇikam
dattvā bhavāya viprebhyaḥ pradadyād dakṣiṇām api //
1.84.d:
राजतं कमलं चैव जांबूनदसुकर्णिकम्
दत्त्वा भवाय विप्रेभ्यः प्रदद्याद् दक्षिणाम् अपि ॥
1.84.m: And having given a silver lotus with a pericarp of gold / to Bhava, she should also bestow a priestly fee upon the Brahmins.

1.84.s:
kāmato 'pi kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ bhrūṇahatyādikaṃ ca yat
tatsarvaṃ śūladānena bhindyānnārī na saṃśayaḥ //
1.84.d:
कामतो ऽपि कृतं पापं भ्रूणहत्यादिकं च यत्
तत्सर्वं शूलदानेन भिन्द्यान्नारी न संशयः ॥
1.84.m: Whatever sin has been committed even intentionally, such as the killing of an embryo, / a woman would destroy all of it by the gift of a trident; there is no doubt.

1.84.s:
sāyujyaṃ caivamāpnoti bhavānyā dvijasattamāḥ
kuryādyadvā naraḥ so 'pi rudrasāyujyamāpnuyāt //
1.84.d:
सायुज्यं चैवमाप्नोति भवान्या द्विजसत्तमाः
कुर्याद्यद्वा नरः सो ऽपि रुद्रसायुज्यमाप्नुयात् ॥
1.84.m: And thus she attains union with Bhavānī, O best of twice-born ones; / or if a man should do it, he too attains union with Rudra.

1.84.s:
paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāṃ varṣamekamatandritā
upavāsaratā nārī naro 'pi dvijasattamāḥ //
1.84.d:
पौर्णमास्याममावास्यां वर्षमेकमतन्द्रिता
उपवासरता नारी नरो ऽपि द्विजसत्तमाः ॥
1.84.m: Unwearied on the full moon and new moon for one year, / a woman or a man devoted to fasting, O best of twice-born ones—

1.84.s:
niyogādeva tatkāryaṃ bhartṝṇāṃ dvijasattamāḥ
japaṃ dānaṃ tapaḥ sarvam asvatantrā yataḥ striyaḥ //
1.84.d:
नियोगादेव तत्कार्यं भर्तॄणां द्विजसत्तमाः
जपं दानं तपः सर्वम् अस्वतन्त्रा यतः स्त्रियः ॥
1.84.m: it must be performed by women only with the permission of their husbands, O best of twice-born ones, / including all recitation, giving, and austerity, since women are not independent.

1.84.s:
varṣānte sarvagandhāḍhyāṃ pratimāṃ saṃnivedayet
sā bhavānyāś ca sāyujyaṃ sārūpyaṃ cāpi suvratā //
1.84.d:
वर्षान्ते सर्वगन्धाढ्यां प्रतिमां संनिवेदयेत्
सा भवान्याश् च सायुज्यं सारूप्यं चापि सुव्रता ॥
1.84.m: At the end of the year, she should present an image endowed with all perfumes; / she, of good vows, [attains] union and sameness of form with Bhavānī;

1.84.s:
labhate nātra saṃdehaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyaham
kārtikyāṃ vā tu yā nārī ekabhaktena vartate //
1.84.d:
लभते नात्र संदेहः सत्यं सत्यं वदाम्यहम्
कार्तिक्यां वा तु या नारी एकभक्तेन वर्तते ॥
1.84.m: she obtains [it], there is no doubt here; I speak the truth, the truth. / Or on the full moon of Kārtika, the woman who subsists on a single meal,

1.84.s:
kṣamāhiṃsādiniyamaiḥ saṃyuktā brahmacāriṇī
dadyātkṛṣṇatilānāṃ ca bhāramekam atandritā //
1.84.d:
क्षमाहिंसादिनियमैः संयुक्ता ब्रह्मचारिणी
दद्यात्कृष्णतिलानां च भारमेकम् अतन्द्रिता ॥
1.84.m: endowed with the observances of forgiveness, non-violence, and the like, observing celibacy, / unwearied, should give one bhāra of black sesame seeds,

1.84.s:
saghṛtaṃ saguḍaṃ caiva odanaṃ parameṣṭhine
dattvā ca brāhmaṇebhyaś ca yathā vibhavavistaram //
1.84.d:
सघृतं सगुडं चैव ओदनं परमेष्ठिने
दत्त्वा च ब्राह्मणेभ्यश् च यथा विभवविस्तरम् ॥
1.84.m: and cooked rice with ghee and with raw sugar to the Supreme Lord; / and having given to Brahmins according to the extent of her wealth,

1.84.s:
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyām upavāsaratā ca sā
bhavānyā modate sārdhaṃ sārūpyaṃ prāpya suvratā //
1.84.d:
अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्याम् उपवासरता च सा
भवान्या मोदते सार्धं सारूप्यं प्राप्य सुव्रता ॥
1.84.m: and devoted to fasting on the eighth and fourteenth [lunar days], / she, of good vows, having attained sameness of form, rejoices with Bhavānī.

1.84.s:
kṣamā satyaṃ dayā dānaṃ śaucamindriyanigrahaḥ
sarvavrateṣvayaṃ dharmaḥ sāmānyo rudrapūjanam //
1.84.d:
क्षमा सत्यं दया दानं शौचमिन्द्रियनिग्रहः
सर्वव्रतेष्वयं धर्मः सामान्यो रुद्रपूजनम् ॥
1.84.m: Forgiveness, truth, compassion, charity, purity, restraint of the senses, / and the worship of Rudra—this is the common duty in all vows.

1.84.s:
samāsādvaḥ pravakṣyāmi pratimāsamanukramāt
mārgaśīrṣakamāsādikārttikāntaṃ yathākramam //
1.84.d:
समासाद्वः प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रतिमासमनुक्रमात्
मार्गशीर्षकमासादिकार्त्तिकान्तं यथाक्रमम् ॥
1.84.m: I shall declare to you concisely, in order month by month, / in proper succession, beginning with the month of Mārgaśīrṣa and ending with Kārtika.

1.84.s:
vrataṃ suvipulaṃ puṇyaṃ nandinā paribhāṣitam
mārgaśīrṣakamāse 'tha vṛṣaṃ pūrṇāṅgamuttamam //
1.84.d:
व्रतं सुविपुलं पुण्यं नन्दिना परिभाषितम्
मार्गशीर्षकमासे ऽथ वृषं पूर्णाङ्गमुत्तमम् ॥
1.84.m:
The very extensive and meritorious observance spoken of by Nandin:
Then, in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, having an excellent bull with all limbs complete,

1.84.s:
alaṃkṛtya yathānyāyaṃ śivāya vinivedayet
sā ca sārdhaṃ bhavānyā vai modate nātra saṃśayaḥ //
1.84.d:
अलंकृत्य यथान्यायं शिवाय विनिवेदयेत्
सा च सार्धं भवान्या वै मोदते नात्र संशयः ॥
1.84.m:
adorned properly, she should present it to Śiva.
And she truly rejoices together with Bhavānī; of this there is no doubt.

1.84.s:
puṣyamāse tu vai śūlaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya nivedayet
pūrvoktamakhilaṃ kṛtvā bhavānyā saha modate //
1.84.d:
पुष्यमासे तु वै शूलं प्रतिष्ठाप्य निवेदयेत्
पूर्वोक्तमखिलं कृत्वा भवान्या सह मोदते ॥
1.84.m:
In the month of Puṣya, having consecrated and offered a trident,
and having done all that was previously mentioned, she rejoices with Bhavānī.

1.84.s:
māghamāse rathaṃ kṛtvā sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam
dadyāt sampūjya deveśaṃ brāhmaṇāṃścaiva bhojayet //
1.84.d:
माघमासे रथं कृत्वा सर्वलक्षणलक्षितम्
दद्यात् सम्पूज्य देवेशं ब्राह्मणांश्चैव भोजयेत् ॥
1.84.m:
In the month of Māgha, having fashioned a chariot endowed with every auspicious mark,
having worshipped the Lord of gods, she should give it away and feed the brahmins.

1.84.s:
sā ca devyā mahābhāgā modate nātra saṃśayaḥ
phālgune pratimāṃ kṛtvā hiraṇyena yathāvidhi //
1.84.d:
सा च देव्या महाभागा मोदते नात्र संशयः
फाल्गुने प्रतिमां कृत्वा हिरण्येन यथाविधि ॥
1.84.m:
And that fortunate woman rejoices with the Goddess; of this there is no doubt.
In Phālguna, having made an image out of gold according to rule,

1.84.s:
rājatenāpi tāmreṇa yathāvibhavavistaram
pratiṣṭhāpya samabhyarcya sthāpayecchaṅkarālaye //
1.84.d:
राजतेनापि ताम्रेण यथाविभवविस्तरम्
प्रतिष्ठाप्य समभ्यर्च्य स्थापयेच्छङ्करालये ॥
1.84.m:
or of silver or copper, according to the extent of one's wealth,
consecrating and properly worshipping it, she should establish it in a temple of Śaṅkara.

1.84.s:
sā ca sārdhaṃ mahādevyā modate nātra saṃśayaḥ
caitre bhavaṃ kumāraṃ ca bhavānīṃ ca yathāvidhi //
1.84.d:
सा च सार्धं महादेव्या मोदते नात्र संशयः
चैत्रे भवं कुमारं च भवानीं च यथाविधि ॥
1.84.m:
And she rejoices together with the Great Goddess; of this there is no doubt.
In Caitra, [having fashioned images of] Bhava, Kumāra, and Bhavānī according to rule,

1.84.s:
tāmrādyairvidhivatkṛtvā pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi
bhavānyā modate sārdhaṃ dattvā rudrāya śaṃbhave //
1.84.d:
ताम्राद्यैर्विधिवत्कृत्वा प्रतिष्ठाप्य यथाविधि
भवान्या मोदते सार्धं दत्त्वा रुद्राय शंभवे ॥
1.84.m:
duly made from copper and other [metals] and consecrated properly,
having given them to Rudra Śambhu, she rejoices with Bhavānī.

1.84.s:
kṛtvālayaṃ hi kauberaṃ rājataṃ rajatena vai
īśvaromāsamāyuktaṃ gaṇeśaiś ca samantataḥ //
1.84.d:
कृत्वालयं हि कौबेरं राजतं रजतेन वै
ईश्वरोमासमायुक्तं गणेशैश् च समन्ततः ॥
1.84.m:
Having made a Kuveran abode of silver, indeed of silver,
accompanied by Īśvara and Umā, and surrounded on all sides by the lords of the Gaṇas,

1.84.s:
sarvaratnasamāyuktaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi
sthāpayetparameśasya bhavasyāyatane śubhe //
1.84.d:
सर्वरत्नसमायुक्तं प्रतिष्ठाप्य यथाविधि
स्थापयेत्परमेशस्य भवस्यायतने शुभे ॥
1.84.m:
furnished with all kinds of jewels, consecrated according to rule,
she should install it in the auspicious temple of Bhava, the Supreme Lord.

1.84.s:
vaiśākhe vai cared evaṃ kailāsākhyaṃ vratottamam
kailāsaparvataṃ prāpya bhavānyā saha modate //
1.84.d:
वैशाखे वै चरेद् एवं कैलासाख्यं व्रतोत्तमम्
कैलासपर्वतं प्राप्य भवान्या सह मोदते ॥
1.84.m:
In Vaiśākha, one should thus perform this best of observances called Kailāsa;
reaching Mount Kailāsa, she rejoices with Bhavānī.

1.84.s:
jyeṣṭhe māsi mahādevaṃ liṅgamūrtimumāpatim
kṛtāñjalipuṭenaiva brahmaṇā viṣṇunā tathā //
1.84.d:
ज्येष्ठे मासि महादेवं लिङ्गमूर्तिमुमापतिम्
कृताञ्जलिपुटेनैव ब्रह्मणा विष्णुना तथा ॥
1.84.m:
In the month of Jyeṣṭha, [making an auspicious image of] Mahādeva, the lord of Umā whose form is the liṅga,
along with Brahmā and Viṣṇu having their hands joined in reverence,

1.84.s:
madhye bhavena saṃyuktaṃ liṅgamūrti dvijottamāḥ
haṃsena ca varāheṇa kṛtvā tāmrādibhiḥ śubhām //
1.84.d:
मध्ये भवेन संयुक्तं लिङ्गमूर्ति द्विजोत्तमाः
हंसेन च वराहेण कृत्वा ताम्रादिभिः शुभाम् ॥
1.84.m:
joined with Bhava in the middle, O best of the twice-born,
and having fashioned the auspicious liṅga-form with the swan and the boar out of copper and other metals,

1.84.s:
pratiṣṭhāpya yathānyāyaṃ brāhmaṇān bhojayettataḥ
śivāya śivamāsādya śivasthāne yathāvidhi //
1.84.d:
प्रतिष्ठाप्य यथान्यायं ब्राह्मणान् भोजयेत्ततः
शिवाय शिवमासाद्य शिवस्थाने यथाविधि ॥
1.84.m:
consecrating it properly, she should then feed the brahmins.
Approaching Śiva for the sake of Śiva, in a place sacred to Śiva, according to rule,

1.84.s:
brāhmaṇaiḥ sahitāṃ sthāpya devyāḥ sāyujyamāpnuyāt
āṣāḍhe ca śubhe māse gṛhaṃ kṛtvā suśobhanam //
1.84.d:
ब्राह्मणैः सहितां स्थाप्य देव्याः सायुज्यमाप्नुयात्
आषाढे च शुभे मासे गृहं कृत्वा सुशोभनम् ॥
1.84.m:
installing it together with the brahmins, she attains union with the Goddess.
And in the auspicious month of Āṣāḍha, having built a beautiful house

1.84.s:
pakveṣṭakābhir vidhivad yathāvibhavavistaram
sarvabījarasaiścāpi sampūrṇaṃ sarvaśobhanaiḥ //
1.84.d:
पक्वेष्टकाभिर् विधिवद् यथाविभवविस्तरम्
सर्वबीजरसैश्चापि सम्पूर्णं सर्वशोभनैः ॥
1.84.m:
with baked bricks according to rule, matching the extent of one's wealth,
filled also with all seeds and juices, possessing all lovely things,

1.84.s:
gṛhopakaraṇaiścaiva musalolūkhalādibhiḥ
dāsīdāsādibhiścaiva śayanairaśanādibhiḥ //
1.84.d:
गृहोपकरणैश्चैव मुसलोलूखलादिभिः
दासीदासादिभिश्चैव शयनैरशनादिभिः ॥
1.84.m:
furnished with household utensils such as pestles and mortars,
with female and male servants, with beds, food, and the like,

1.84.s:
sampūrṇaiś ca gṛhaṃ vastrair ācchādya ca samantataḥ
devaṃ ghṛtādibhiḥ snāpya mahādevamumāpatim //
1.84.d:
सम्पूर्णैश् च गृहं वस्त्रैर् आच्छाद्य च समन्ततः
देवं घृतादिभिः स्नाप्य महादेवमुमापतिम् ॥
1.84.m:
and covering the fully-equipped house completely on all sides with cloths,
having bathed the god, Mahādeva, the lord of Umā, with ghee and other substances,

1.84.s:
brāhmaṇānāṃ sahasraṃ ca bhojayitvā yathāvidhi
vidyāvinayasampannaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam //
1.84.d:
ब्राह्मणानां सहस्रं च भोजयित्वा यथाविधि
विद्याविनयसम्पन्नं ब्राह्मणं वेदपारगम् ॥
1.84.m:
and having fed a thousand brahmins according to rule,
[and having found] a brahmin endowed with learning and modesty, who has mastered the Vedas,

1.84.s:
prathamāśramiṇaṃ bhaktyā sampūjya ca yathāvidhi
kanyāṃ sumadhyamāṃ yāvat kālajīvanasaṃyutām //
1.84.d:
प्रथमाश्रमिणं भक्त्या सम्पूज्य च यथाविधि
कन्यां सुमध्यमां यावत् कालजीवनसंयुताम् ॥
1.84.m:
and is in the first stage of life, having worshipped him with devotion according to rule,
[and given him] a slender-waisted maiden who has means of living for a lifetime,

1.84.s:
kṣetraṃ gomithunaṃ caiva tadgṛhe ca nivedayet
sāyanair vividhair divyair meruparvatasannibhaiḥ //
1.84.d:
क्षेत्रं गोमिथुनं चैव तद्गृहे च निवेदयेत्
सायनैर् विविधैर् दिव्यैर् मेरुपर्वतसन्निभैः ॥
1.84.m:
she should offer in that house a field, a pair of cattle,
and various divine couch-beds resembling Mount Meru.

1.84.s:
golokaṃ samanuprāpya bhavānyā saha modate
bhavānyā sadṛśībhūtvā sarvakalpeṣu sāvyayā //
1.84.d:
गोलोकं समनुप्राप्य भवान्या सह मोदते
भवान्या सदृशीभूत्वा सर्वकल्पेषु साव्यया ॥
1.84.m:
Having attained Goloka, she rejoices with Bhavānī.
Becoming equal to Bhavānī in all kalpas, imperishable,

1.84.s:
bhavānyāścaiva sāyujyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ
sarvadhātusamākīrṇaṃ vicitradhvajaśobhitam //
1.84.d:
भवान्याश्चैव सायुज्यं लभते नात्र संशयः
सर्वधातुसमाकीर्णं विचित्रध्वजशोभितम् ॥
1.84.m:
she attains union with Bhavānī; of this there is no doubt.
Filled with all minerals and adorned with varied banners,

1.84.s:
nivedayīta śarvāya śrāvaṇe tilaparvatam
vitānadhvajavastrādyair dhātubhiś ca nivedayet //
1.84.d:
निवेदयीत शर्वाय श्रावणे तिलपर्वतम्
वितानध्वजवस्त्राद्यैर् धातुभिश् च निवेदयेत् ॥
1.84.m:
she should offer a mountain of sesame seeds to Śarva in Śrāvaṇa;
she should offer it with canopies, banners, cloths, and minerals.

1.84.s:
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca pūrvoktamakhilaṃ bhavet
kṛtvā bhādrapade māsi śobhanaṃ śāliparvatam //
1.84.d:
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च पूर्वोक्तमखिलं भवेत्
कृत्वा भाद्रपदे मासि शोभनं शालिपर्वतम् ॥
1.84.m:
And having fed the brahmins, everything previously mentioned shall come to pass.
Having made a splendid mountain of rice in the month of Bhādrapada,

1.84.s:
vitānadhvajavastrādyair dhātubhiś ca nivedayet
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca dāpayecca yathāvidhi //
1.84.d:
वितानध्वजवस्त्राद्यैर् धातुभिश् च निवेदयेत्
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च दापयेच्च यथाविधि ॥
1.84.m:
she should present it with canopies, banners, cloths, and minerals.
Having fed the brahmins, she should also cause it to be given away according to rule.

1.84.s:
sā ca sūryāṃśusaṃkāśā bhavānyā saha modate
kṛtvā cāśvayuje māsi vipulaṃ dhānyaparvatam //
1.84.d:
सा च सूर्यांशुसंकाशा भवान्या सह मोदते
कृत्वा चाश्वयुजे मासि विपुलं धान्यपर्वतम् ॥
1.84.m:
And she, radiant as a sunbeam, rejoices with Bhavānī.
Having fashioned an abundant mountain of grain in the month of Āśvayuja,

1.84.s:
suvarṇavastrasaṃyuktaṃ dattvā sampūjya śaṅkaram
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca pūrvoktamakhilaṃ bhavet //
1.84.d:
सुवर्णवस्त्रसंयुक्तं दत्त्वा सम्पूज्य शङ्करम्
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च पूर्वोक्तमखिलं भवेत् ॥
1.84.m:
furnished with gold and garments, having given it after worshipping Śaṅkara,
and having fed the brahmins, everything previously mentioned shall come to pass.

1.84.s:
sarvadhānyasamāyuktaṃ sarvabījarasādibhiḥ
sarvadhātusamāyuktaṃ sarvaratnopaśobhitam //
1.84.d:
सर्वधान्यसमायुक्तं सर्वबीजरसादिभिः
सर्वधातुसमायुक्तं सर्वरत्नोपशोभितम् ॥
1.84.m:
[A mountain] endowed with all grains, with all seeds, juices, and the like,
endowed with all minerals, adorned with all jewels,

1.84.s:
śṛṅgaiścaturbhiḥ saṃyuktaṃ vitānacchatraśobhitam
gandhamālyais tathā dhūpaiś citraiścāpi suśobhitam //
1.84.d:
शृङ्गैश्चतुर्भिः संयुक्तं वितानच्छत्रशोभितम्
गन्धमाल्यैस् तथा धूपैश् चित्रैश्चापि सुशोभितम् ॥
1.84.m:
furnished with four peaks, adorned with canopies and parasols,
and beautifully decorated with perfumes, garlands, and varied incense,

1.84.s:
vicitrairnṛtyageyaiś ca śaṅkhavīṇādibhis tathā
brahmaghoṣairmahāpuṇyaṃ maṅgalaiś ca viśeṣataḥ //
1.84.d:
विचित्रैर्नृत्यगेयैश् च शङ्खवीणादिभिस् तथा
ब्रह्मघोषैर्महापुण्यं मङ्गलैश् च विशेषतः ॥
1.84.m:
accompanied by varied dances and songs, by conches, vīṇās, and the like,
and especially made most meritorious by the chanting of the Vedas and auspicious sounds,

1.84.s:
mahādhvajāṣṭasaṃyuktaṃ vicitrakusumojjvalam
nagendraṃ merunāmānaṃ trailokyādhāramuttamam //
1.84.d:
महाध्वजाष्टसंयुक्तं विचित्रकुसुमोज्ज्वलम्
नगेन्द्रं मेरुनामानं त्रैलोक्याधारमुत्तमम् ॥
1.84.m:
furnished with eight great banners, radiant with variegated flowers,
[representing] the king of mountains named Meru, the excellent foundation of the three worlds—

1.84.s:
tasya mūrdhni śivaṃ kuryān madhyato dhātunaiva tu
dakṣiṇe ca yathānyāyaṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca caturmukham //
1.84.d:
तस्य मूर्ध्नि शिवं कुर्यान् मध्यतो धातुनैव तु
दक्षिणे च यथान्यायं ब्रह्माणं च चतुर्मुखम् ॥
1.84.m:
on its summit she should place Śiva made of mineral in the middle,
and on the south, properly, the four-faced Brahmā,

1.84.s:
uttare devadeveśaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam
indrādilokapālāṃś ca kṛtvā bhaktyā yathāvidhi //
1.84.d:
उत्तरे देवदेवेशं नारायणमनामयम्
इन्द्रादिलोकपालांश् च कृत्वा भक्त्या यथाविधि ॥
1.84.m:
on the north Nārāyaṇa, the flawless Lord of the lords of the gods;
and having fashioned the world-protectors headed by Indra with devotion according to rule,

1.84.s:
pratiṣṭhāpya tataḥ snāpya samabhyarcya maheśvaram
devasya dakṣiṇe haste śūlaṃ tridaśapūjitam //
1.84.d:
प्रतिष्ठाप्य ततः स्नाप्य समभ्यर्च्य महेश्वरम्
देवस्य दक्षिणे हस्ते शूलं त्रिदशपूजितम् ॥
1.84.m:
and consecrated them, then having bathed and worshipped Maheśvara,
[she should place] in the right hand of the god the trident worshipped by the thirty [gods],

1.84.s:
vāme pāśaṃ bhavānyāś ca kamalaṃ hemabhūṣitam
viṣṇoś ca śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ ca gadāmabjaṃ prayatnataḥ //
1.84.d:
वामे पाशं भवान्याश् च कमलं हेमभूषितम्
विष्णोश् च शङ्खं चक्रं च गदामब्जं प्रयत्नतः ॥
1.84.m:
and in the left a noose; and Bhavānī's lotus adorned with gold;
and diligently [fashion] Viṣṇu's conch, discus, mace, and lotus,

1.84.s:
brahmaṇaścākṣasūtraṃ ca kamaṇḍalumanuttamam
indrasya vajram agneś ca śaktyākhyaṃ paramāyudham //
1.84.d:
ब्रह्मणश्चाक्षसूत्रं च कमण्डलुमनुत्तमम्
इन्द्रस्य वज्रम् अग्नेश् च शक्त्याख्यं परमायुधम् ॥
1.84.m:
Brahmā's rosary and peerless water-pot,
Indra's thunderbolt, and Agni's supreme weapon named the spear,

1.84.s:
yamasya daṇḍaṃ nirṛteḥ khaḍgaṃ niśicarasya tu
varuṇasya mahāpāśaṃ nāgākhyaṃ rudramadbhutam //
1.84.d:
यमस्य दण्डं निरृतेः खड्गं निशिचरस्य तु
वरुणस्य महापाशं नागाख्यं रुद्रमद्भुतम् ॥
1.84.m:
Yama's staff, Nirṛti the demon's sword,
Varuṇa's great wonder-working Rudra-noose known as the serpent,

1.84.s:
vāyor yaṣṭiṃ kuberasya gadāṃ lokaprapūjitām
ṭaṅkaṃ ceśānadevasya nivedyaivaṃ krameṇa ca //
1.84.d:
वायोर् यष्टिं कुबेरस्य गदां लोकप्रपूजिताम्
टङ्कं चेशानदेवस्य निवेद्यैवं क्रमेण च ॥
1.84.m:
Vāyu's staff, Kubera's mace revered by the world,
and the chisel of the god Īśāna; having thus offered these in due order,

1.84.s:
śivasya mahatīṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā carusamanvitām
pūjayetsarvadevāṃś ca yathāvibhavavistaram //
1.84.d:
शिवस्य महतीं पूजां कृत्वा चरुसमन्विताम्
पूजयेत्सर्वदेवांश् च यथाविभवविस्तरम् ॥
1.84.m:
and having performed a grand worship of Śiva accompanied by an oblation of boiled rice,
she should worship all the deities according to the extent of her wealth.

1.84.s:
brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā ca pūjāṃ kṛtvā prayatnataḥ
mahāmeruvrataṃ kṛtvā mahādevāya dāpayet //
1.84.d:
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयित्वा च पूजां कृत्वा प्रयत्नतः
महामेरुव्रतं कृत्वा महादेवाय दापयेत् ॥
1.84.m:
